AI.conclusion: 将可学习外部先验与当前图像内部先验高效融合，并通过对齐机制增强先验一致性，可在保持线性复杂度和单网络可变码率能力的同时显著提升图像压缩效率与速度，说明跨图像通用先验是学习型图像压缩中的重要增益来源。

title: UniGADD: Universal Generator-Agnostic Deepfake Detector
summary: In this paper, we introduce Universal Generator-Agnostic Deepfake Detector (UniGADD), a novel method that employs supervised learning to achieve high accuracy on known deepfake generators, while maintaining robust performance on previously unseen ones. The proposed approach follows a two-stage optimisation process. In the first stage, a contrastive loss encourages the model to learn discriminative feature embeddings from real and known fake images, resulting in strong performance within the training domain. In the second stage, the embedding space is refined by promoting inter-cluster separation and intra-cluster compactness, applied exclusively to real samples. This refinement enhances generalisability, enabling the method to exhibit improved robustness against unseen deepfake generation techniques. UniGADD achieves accuracy on par with state-of-the-art methods for known generators, while significantly outperforming them on unseen cases, demonstrating its scalability and practical applicability for adversarial content detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniGADD，通过两阶段监督学习同时提升对已知深度伪造生成器的识别精度与对未知生成器的泛化鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测模型往往在已知生成器上表现较好，但面对未见过的伪造生成方法时泛化能力不足；需要一种能兼顾已知场景高精度和未知场景鲁棒性的检测器。
AI.method: UniGADD采用两阶段优化：第一阶段使用对比损失，从真实图像和已知伪造图像中学习判别性特征嵌入，以提升已知域内的检测性能；第二阶段仅针对真实样本优化嵌入空间，促进不同类别簇之间分离、同一类簇内部紧凑，从而增强模型对未知伪造生成器的泛化能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，UniGADD在已知深度伪造生成器上的准确率可与当前最先进方法相当，同时在未见过的生成器上显著优于现有方法，展现出良好的可扩展性和实用价值。
AI.conclusion: UniGADD通过“先学习已知伪造判别特征，再基于真实样本精炼嵌入空间”的策略，有效平衡了已知场景精度与未知场景鲁棒性，适用于对抗性虚假内容检测。

title: Generator-Aligned Reward Modeling with Target-Aware Bounded Optimization for Visual Generation
summary: Post-training aims to enhance desired attributes in visual generative models while preserving their general generation capabilities. Reward-guided post-training faces two challenges: real training data may mismatch the generator's output distribution, and attribute supervision may be confounded by unrelated content. Unbounded reward maximization can also cause overoptimization and degrade generation quality. We propose a framework combining Generator-Aligned Reward Modeling (GARM) and Target-Aware Bounded Optimization (TABO). GARM mitigates distribution mismatch through generator-support matching and reduces content confounding using content-matched real contrasts, yielding generator-relevant, attribute-focused reward supervision. TABO maps the learned reward to a smooth, upper-bounded function calibrated from real target-positive examples. This transformation is independent of the optimization algorithm and supports both direct reward-gradient and policy-based optimization. We further introduce Target-Aware GRPO (TA-GRPO), an adaptation of Flow-GRPO that combines fixed stage-wise advantage scaling, a generator-to-target curriculum, and timestep-balanced credit assignment for flow-based video optimization. Experiments show that GARM improves target-attribute expression while maintaining competitive generation quality. TABO better balances attribute enhancement and visual quality than unconstrained reward maximization, while TA-GRPO improves target enhancement over vanilla Flow-GRPO and reduces unintended attribute leakage on neutral prompts. These results highlight the importance of generator-aligned reward supervision and controlled, data-calibrated optimization for targeted visual generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向视觉生成模型后训练的奖励引导框架，通过生成器对齐奖励建模与目标感知的有界优化缓解奖励监督偏差和过度优化问题，从而在增强目标属性的同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 奖励引导后训练面临三方面挑战：真实训练数据与生成器输出分布可能不匹配，属性监督信号易受无关内容混淆，以及无约束奖励最大化会导致过度优化并损害整体生成质量。
AI.method: 作者提出 Generator-Aligned Reward Modeling（GARM）和 Target-Aware Bounded Optimization（TABO）。GARM 通过生成器支持集匹配和与内容对齐的真实对照样本，使奖励监督更贴近生成器分布并聚焦目标属性；TABO 将学习到的奖励映射为平滑且有上界的函数，并用真实目标正样本校准，从而兼容直接奖励梯度优化和基于策略的优化。此外提出 Target-Aware GRPO（TA-GRPO），结合阶段化优势缩放、生成器到目标的课程学习和时间步均衡的信用分配，用于基于流模型的视觉生成后训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，GARM 能在保持生成质量的同时提升目标属性表达；TABO 相比无约束奖励最大化更好地平衡属性增强与视觉质量；TA-GRPO 相比原始 Flow-GRPO 提升目标属性增强，并减少中性提示中的无关属性泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，针对视觉生成模型的目标化后训练需要生成器对齐的奖励监督机制，以及由真实数据校准的有界优化策略，才能稳定提升目标属性并避免质量退化或属性泄漏。

title: ArtCrafter: Feed-Forward Generation of Articulated 3D Object with Analytic Joint Derivation
summary: Articulated 3D assets are essential for robotic simulation and training, yet their generation from casual images poses a key challenge: recovering part geometry and kinematics that remain mutually consistent. We present ArtCrafter, a novel feed-forward generative model for controllable generation of articulated 3D objects from a pair of images, one depicting the object in the rest state and the other in the open state. At the core of ArtCrafter is a DiT-based generative model that jointly produces part-level meshes for both articulation states in a single forward pass. Inspired by Slot Attention, its denoising process operates on a $1+2N$ slot layout comprising one shared base slot and $N$ paired rest/open slots, encouraging each pair to bind to the same kinematic part. To ensure geometrically consistent and disjoint part generation, we introduce Triplet Attention to enforce cross-state geometric consistency between paired rest/open slots anchored through the shared base slot, and a repulsion loss $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rep}}$ on decoded part point clouds to prevent inter-part penetration throughout denoising. Given the resulting paired meshes, URDF joint parameters---type, axis, origin, and range---are derived analytically from the rigid transformation between each rest/open pair, providing an interpretable alternative to learned joint-parameter regression. Extensive experiments on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution datasets demonstrate that ArtCrafter outperforms existing method under the same dual-state setting in geometry quality and articulation precision, while remaining competitive with methods operating under different input settings and paradigms.

AI.tldr: ArtCrafter是一种基于DiT的前馈生成模型，从物体的闭合态和开启态两张图像同时生成几何一致、可解释的关节化3D部件网格及URDF关节参数。
AI.motivation: 从普通图像恢复可动3D物体的难点在于同时获得一致的部件几何和运动学参数，尤其要让同一部件在两个状态下的形状、位置和关节关系相互绑定，避免部件穿透和状态错配。
AI.method: 核心方法是采用DiT式联合去噪：使用“1个共享底座槽位 + 2N个成对闭合/开启槽位”的槽位结构，使每个闭合/开启槽位对绑定到同一运动部件；提出Triplet Attention，以共享底座为锚点强制成对槽位间的跨状态几何一致性；引入排斥损失，约束解码后的部件点云在去噪过程中避免部件间穿透。最终根据每个成对部件的刚体变换解析估计URDF关节参数，包括关节类型、转轴、原点和运动范围。
AI.result: 在分布内和分布外数据集上的实验表明，ArtCrafter在相同双态输入设置下优于现有方法，能够生成更高质量的几何结果和更准确的关节参数；与输入条件和范式不同的方法相比也具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: ArtCrafter通过槽位绑定、跨状态注意力约束和物理排斥正则，实现了从两张状态图像可靠生成可动3D资产及其可解释关节结构，为机器人仿真训练提供了高质量、可使用的关节化3D生成方案。

title: Which Objects Stay? Learning Hierarchical Persistence Beliefs for Lifelong Open-Vocabulary Object Maps
summary: Lifelong object maps must estimate whether an object remains at its previously observed location after it leaves view. Existing persistence filters rely on class-based survival priors, making them difficult to apply reliably in open-vocabulary settings. We introduce HiPer, a hierarchical persistence filter that derives persistence beliefs directly from data rather than semantic categories. For a new object, HiPer retrieves visually and geometrically similar training instances and estimates an initial survival rate from their observed histories, without requiring class labels. This estimate initializes a conjugate Beta belief over the object's survival probability, which is updated in closed form using detections and missed observations under Rosen's persistence-filter framework. When an object is re-identified at a new location, its persistence belief is transferred with the object, enabling the map to learn object-specific mobility over time. Experiments on 120 held-out simulated sequences show that HiPer consistently achieves the best performance among competing methods. Retrieval-based priors outperform CLIP-derived label priors, and object-specific online learning provides further gains. Results on 47 held-out 3RScan environments demonstrate that the proposed retrieval-based prior also outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiPer，一种层次化持久性滤波器，通过检索相似训练样本估计物体的初始生存概率，并在对象被重新识别时迁移该信念，以构建终身开放词汇物体地图。
AI.motivation: 终身物体地图需要判断物体离开视野后是否仍在原位置。现有方法依赖类别级生存先验，在开放词汇场景中可靠性不足，因此需要从数据中学习更通用、对象级的持久性信念。
AI.method: HiPer首先为新物体检索视觉和几何相似的训练实例，并基于它们的历史观测估计初始生存率；随后用共轭Beta分布表示物体存活概率，并在Rosen持久性滤波框架下根据检测与漏检更新信念。当物体在新位置被重新识别时，将其持久性信念随对象迁移，从而学习对象自身的移动性。
AI.result: 在120段留出模拟序列上，HiPer取得了优于对比方法的性能。检索得到的先验优于基于CLIP标签的先验，且对象级在线学习进一步提升效果。在47个留出的3RScan真实环境中，检索先验同样优于当前先进基线。
AI.conclusion: HiPer能够不依赖类别标签，从数据中直接学习物体持久性，并通过对象信念迁移适应开放词汇的终身物体建图，在模拟和真实场景中均表现出更强的有效性和泛化能力。

title: CoGenRec: A Unified Generative Framework for Complementary Vision Reconstruction
summary: Capturing scenes with extreme motion and high dynamic range is fundamentally constrained by trade-offs among temporal resolution, spatial detail, signal-to-noise ratio, and dynamic range under practical bandwidth, power, and quantum-efficiency limits. Conventional frame-based cameras therefore suffer from temporal undersampling, exposure-induced motion blur, and sensor saturation. The Complementary Vision Sensor (CVS) addresses these limitations by decomposing visual information across two complementary pathways, a spatially dense, temporally sparse, long-exposure RGB pathway and a temporally dense, spatially sparse, short-exposure patiotemporal difference pathway. Their complementary measurements provide appearance, structural, and motion cues across a wide dynamic range that enable reconstruction beyond conventional imaging. We present CoGenRec, a complementarity-driven generative reconstruction framework that unifies video deblurring, high-temporal-resolution frame interpolation, and HDR fusion. CoGenRec encodes complementary measurements into multi-scale spatiotemporal features using exposure-aware appearance modeling and bidirectional temporal propagation. These features constrain a video diffusion model and are injected into the VAE decoder to recover fine structures lost during latent-space compression, combining the scene fidelity of physical measurements with the appearance recovery capabilities of learned video priors. On SportsSloMo-CVS, CoGenRec improves PSNR over the strongest general-purpose baseline by 4.40 dB for deblurring, 3.89 dB for frame interpolation, and 5.04 dB for HDR fusion, respectively. It also achieves strong perceptual quality on 129 unseen scenes captured with real CVS. These results establish a unified approach to advance high-quality reconstruction under challenging motion and illumination conditions. Project page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: CVS/CoGenRec uses complementary long- and short-exposure vision measurements with a diffusion-based generative reconstruction framework to jointly enable video deblurring, high-temporal-resolution frame interpolation, and HDR fusion.
AI.motivation: Under extreme motion and high dynamic range scenes, conventional frame-based cameras are limited by the practical trade-offs among temporal resolution, spatial detail, signal-to-noise ratio, and dynamic range, leading to temporal undersampling, exposure-induced motion blur, and sensor saturation.
AI.method: The Complementary Vision Sensor (CVS) decomposes visual information into two complementary paths: a spatially dense, temporally sparse, long-exposure RGB path for appearance and structure, and a temporally dense, spatially sparse, short-exposure spatiotemporal-difference path for motion cues. CoGenRec then encodes these measurements into multi-scale spatiotemporal features using exposure-aware appearance modeling and bidirectional temporal propagation. These features constrain a video diffusion model and are injected into the VAE decoder to restore fine structures lost during latent-space compression, thereby combining physical measurement fidelity with learned video priors.
AI.result: On SportsSloMo-CVS, CoGenRec outperforms the strongest general-purpose baseline by 4.40 dB in PSNR for video deblurring, 3.89 dB for frame interpolation, and 5.04 dB for HDR fusion, and also achieves strong perceptual quality on 129 unseen real CVS-captured scenes.
AI.conclusion: The work establishes a unified, complementarity-driven generative reconstruction approach that improves high-quality video reconstruction under challenging motion and illumination conditions.

title: Egocentric Action Recognition with Objects and Vision-Language Affordances
summary: Action recognition, and more specifically egocentric action recognition, is a core task in computer vision, with applications such as monitoring the daily life activities of elderly people and task assistance. Recent methods rely on visual modalities such as RGB video or depth. However, in egocentric video, an action is largely defined by its objects, which these methods rarely model. We propose a method that combines a frozen SlowFast video expert with an attention-based object expert by late fusion. Each object is represented with its affordances, that is, what can be done with it, generated zero-shot by a vision-language model. Since datasets such as MECCANO annotate only the objects involved in each action, evaluating with these boxes tells the model which objects are active. We therefore train on annotated boxes and evaluate the method with detections from the official active-object detector, and with annotated boxes as an upper bound. Without affordances, our fusion reaches 68.4% Top-1 with annotated boxes but 49.0% with detections. About half of this drop comes from non-active detections. To remove them, the same vision-language model generates an interaction affordance that decides whether a hand is manipulating each detected object. On MECCANO, objects raise the Top-1 of the video expert from 44.9% to 49.0%, and the two affordances raise it to 49.9%, above SlowFast and object-aware RGB baselines. Code will be released upon acceptance.
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Under review at IEEE FG 2027

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向第一视角动作识别的“视频专家 + 物体专家”晚融合框架：用冻结 SlowFast 建模动作视觉时序，用 VLM 生成的 object affordances 描述物体可供性，并进一步生成交互可供性过滤非活动物体检测。在 MECCANO 上，物体信息将 SlowFast Top-1 从 44.9% 提升到 49.0%，加入两类 affordances 后达 49.9%，优于相关基线。
AI.motivation: 第一视角动作很大程度由操作对象定义，但现有 egocentric action recognition 方法主要依赖 RGB/depth 等视觉模态，较少显式建模物体及其可供性。此外，MECCANO 等数据集只标注参与动作的对象，若直接用标注框评估会泄露“活动物体”信息；更现实的设置是使用物体检测器，但检测中的非活动物体会显著损害融合模型性能，因此需要同时建模物体语义与手-物交互。
AI.method: 方法包含以下组件：(1) 冻结 SlowFast 视频专家，用于提取第一视角视频时序动作特征。(2) 注意力式物体专家，将每个物体表示为视觉-语言模型 zero-shot 生成的 affordance，即“该物体可被怎样操作/可用于什么动作”。(3) 采用晚融合策略结合视频表征与物体表征。评估上区分两种协议：用标注框作为上界，用官方 active-object detector 的检测结果作为更接近现实的性能。为解决检测结果中的非活动物体噪声，作者进一步用同一 VLM 生成 interaction affordance，判断手是否在操作每个检测物体，从而过滤或抑制无关物体。
AI.result: 在不使用 affordances 的融合模型中，Top-1 在标注框设置下达到 68.4%，但在检测结果下降至 49.0%，说明约一半性能下降来自非活动物体检测。单独引入物体信息后，视频专家 Top-1 从 44.9% 提升到 49.0%；同时加入对象可供性与交互可供性后进一步提升到 49.9%，超过 SlowFast 基线和物体感知 RGB 基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，第一视角动作识别不能仅依赖视频外观，显式建模动作相关物体及其可供性是有效的改进方向。VLM 生成的 affordances 和 hand-object interaction affordances 能缓解现实检测设置下非活动物体带来的噪声，从而提升 egocentric action recognition 性能。但标注框上界仍明显高于检测框结果，说明物体检测质量与活动物体判别仍是该问题的关键瓶颈。

title: GEKey: Learning Geodesic Eccentric 3D Keypoints via Self-Supervision
summary: Point clouds represent 3D object geometry as sets of spatial coordinates. A fundamental task in their analysis is keypoint detection, i.e., identifying a sparse subset of points that captures the most salient features. While supervised methods rely on manual annotations, unsupervised approaches leverage intrinsic geometric properties to localize keypoints without human input. We introduce GEKey, a self-supervised framework that uses the geodesic eccentricity transform, an SE(3)-invariant geometric measure, to identify instance-specific salient points. These points serve as pseudo-labels to train a model that aligns its predictions with the object's intrinsic structure. GEKey is simple, efficient, and robust, preserving intra-class variation by balancing instance-specific and category-level structure. Extensive experiments on ShapeNetCoreV2, KeypointNet, CAPE, ITOP, and DeformingThings4D show state-of-the-art performance in both keypoint detection and alignment, with strong resilience to noise, downsampling, deformations, and real-world conditions. The code and pretrained models are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GEKey，一种基于测地线偏心率变换的自监督点云关键点检测方法，用其作为伪标签训练模型，实现无标注、鲁棒且保持实例差异的关键点检测与对齐。
AI.motivation: 点云关键点检测通常依赖人工标注，监督方法成本高且泛化受限；已有无监督方法需要更自动、几何敏感且稳健地发现物体本质结构中的显著点。
AI.method: 作者利用SE(3)不变的测地线偏心率变换作为几何显著性度量，为每个实例自动选取关键点伪标签，并训练模型使预测对齐物体内在结构，同时在实例特定结构与类别层面结构之间平衡。
AI.result: 在ShapeNetCoreV2、KeypointNet、CAPE、ITOP和DeformingThings4D上，GEKey在关键点检测与对齐任务上达到当前最优性能，并对噪声、下采样、形变及真实场景条件表现出较强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GEKey提供了一种简单、高效且无需人工标注的点云关键点学习框架，能够通过几何先验保留实例差异并提升真实场景中的稳定性。

title: DEQ-Det: Dual Evidence Queries for Few-Shot Analog IC Device Detection
summary: Detecting analog integrated circuit (IC) devices in layout images supports circuit analysis and inspection. With only a few annotated examples, variation in device geometry and visual similarity to dummy or routing structures make reliable detection difficult. Foreground similarity alone can highlight plausible targets without distinguishing them from competing layout patterns. We propose Dual Evidence Queries for Detection (DEQ-Det), which constructs complementary foreground and background references from the same support images without additional annotations. Foreground references capture target morphology, while selected background references characterize surrounding layout patterns. Both sources guide query selection and region verification, combining target appearance with layout context. Across five held-out device categories and three random seeds, DEQ-Det achieves macro AP50 of 39.41 and 53.03 at 10 and 30 shots, exceeding the strongest listed baselines by 3.97 and 9.71 points, respectively. A matched 30-shot ablation further shows that RoI background evidence reduces pooled false positives at comparable recall, supporting its role in interference suppression.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DEQ-Det，一种面向模拟集成电路版图图像的少样本目标检测方法，通过从同一支持图中构建前景与背景双重证据查询，提高对器件几何变化和相似干扰结构的检测鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 模拟 IC 版图中的器件检测通常标注样本有限，同时器件几何形状多样，并容易与 dummy、走线或周围布局结构在视觉上相似。仅依赖前景相似性会产生大量看似合理但错误的候选区域，因此需要同时利用目标外观和上下文背景信息来抑制干扰。
AI.method: DEQ-Det 从少量支持图像中自动构建互补的前景和背景参考，而无需额外标注。前景参考用于刻画目标器件形态，背景参考用于表征周围布局模式。两类证据共同引导查询生成与区域验证，使检测过程同时考虑目标外观与版图的上下文信息。实验在五个未见器件类别和三个随机种子上进行评估。
AI.result: 在 10-shot 和 30-shot 设置下，DEQ-Det 的 macro AP50 分别达到 39.41 和 53.03，相较最强对比方法提升 3.97 和 9.71 个百分点。消融实验表明，加入 RoI 背景证据后，在召回率相近的情况下能够降低合并后的假阳性，说明背景证据有助于抑制干扰。
AI.conclusion: DEQ-Det 通过引入前景和背景双重证据查询，有效弥补了少样本模拟 IC 版图器件检测中仅依赖目标外观的不足，能够提升对相似布局干扰的区分能力，并带来显著检测性能增益。

title: ReferClaw: Disambiguating User Intent for Egocentric Assistance
summary: Users of egocentric AI assistants often ask short, ambiguous questions whose intended referents cannot be uniquely resolved from video and dialogue history. For example, "Where did I leave it?" may refer to several previously handled objects. Existing VideoQA systems typically commit to a single interpretation, risking plausible but intention-misaligned answers. We introduce ReferClaw, an agentic framework that formulates egocentric streaming QA as an interactive process: the assistant asks clarifying questions to resolve user intent before answering. Three cooperating agents identify candidate interpretations, request clarification, and generate answers grounded in the resolved intent and visual evidence. A bounded, cost-aware policy balances expected information gain against user effort while limiting clarification turns and question complexity. Referclaw learns from interaction through intent-specific skill updates and process-reward-guided policy optimization with agent-level credit assignment. Evaluations on augmented egocentric QA benchmarks demonstrate improved answer accuracy and joint answer-and-grounding performance over existing baselines, alongside zero-shot transfer across datasets. These findings support interactive clarification as a practical approach to resolving online user intent in egocentric streaming assistance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ReferClaw，将第一人称流式视频问答建模为交互式澄清过程，在回答前通过追问消解用户意图歧义，从而提升答案准确性与证据对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 第一人称AI助手中，用户常提出简短、模糊的问题，例如“我把东西放哪了？”，仅凭视频和对话历史难以唯一确定指代对象。现有视频问答系统通常直接选择单一解释，容易给出看似合理但偏离用户真实意图的答案，因此需要能够主动澄清意图的机制。
AI.method: 提出Agentic框架ReferClaw，将第一人称流式QA视为交互过程：助手先提出澄清问题再回答。系统包含三个协作智能体，分别负责识别候选解释、请求澄清、基于已消解意图和视觉证据生成答案。同时设计有界、成本感知的策略，在信息收益与用户负担之间权衡，限制澄清轮数和提问复杂度。进一步通过意图相关技能更新、过程奖励引导的策略优化以及智能体级信用分配，从交互中学习改进。
AI.result: 在增强版第一人称QA基准上评估，相比现有基线方法提升了答案准确率，以及答案与视觉定位的联合表现，并展示了跨数据集的零样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 交互式澄清是解决第一人称流式辅助中在线用户意图歧义的有效且实用方案。通过主动提问、证据化回答和受控交互策略，可以在不显著增加用户负担的情况下提升系统理解与回答的可靠性。

title: FlyingDrones: A Dataset and Benchmark for Optical Flow Estimation from UAV motion
summary: Optical flow is an important cue for drone analysis in aerial surveillance, airspace monitoring, and long-range target tracking, where motion remains informative when appearance is weak. Estimating the motion of small Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, however, is difficult because distant targets occupy few pixels, have low contrast, and move against complex dynamic backgrounds. Standard optical-flow benchmarks emphasize large, object-centric motions and therefore do not characterize distant aerial targets well. We introduce FlyingDrones, a generated benchmark with dense ground-truth optical flow and segmentation masks derived from physically based rendering, and define resolution-normalized metrics (EPE Norm) that normalize flow by image dimensions. We evaluate 16 state-of-the-art model families on a motion- and size-stratified subset of 999 flow pairs at three resolutions. Every family recovers drone motion better than the zero-flow reference, but the gap between families widens with resolution: at 1920x1080, global-matching, recurrent, transformer, and short-window temporal models separate clearly from pyramid, classical, self-supervised, lightweight, and diffusion models. Within-family checkpoint spread is comparable to or larger than between-family spread, so the training curriculum is as important as the architecture. Two complementary studies test the benchmark beyond synthetic accuracy: a ground-truth-free motion-alignment evaluation on 21 cameras of real UAV footage shows that the synthetic ranking carries a moderate, significant signal about real-world performance (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.63 over 41 checkpoints) while the exact top ranks differ, and a fine-tuning study shows that 800 FlyingDrones pairs reduce held-out drone-region error by up to 37% and improve drone localization on the real footage for all four architectures tested.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用于远距离无人机光流估计的生成式基准 FlyingDrones，并用分辨率归一化指标评估多种先进模型；同时通过真实 UAV 数据和对微调实验验证该基准的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在航拍监视、空域监控和远距离目标跟踪中，当目标外观弱时，运动线索很重要。但小尺寸无人机像素少、对比度低、背景动态复杂，现有光流基准主要面向大目标，难以评估远距离空中目标的运动估计能力。
AI.method: 作者基于物理渲染生成密集光流和分割标注，建立 FlyingDrones 基准；提出分辨率归一化的 EPE Norm 指标；在 999 个按运动和目标大小分层的流对上、以三种分辨率评估 16 类 SOTA 模型。此外，在 21 个真实无人机摄像机片段上进行无需真值的运动对齐评估，并通过 800 个 FlyingDrones 样本微调测试真实域适配效果。
AI.result: 所有模型族均优于零流基线，但分辨率越高，模型族之间差距越大。1080p 下，全局匹配、循环、Transformer 和短时窗时序模型明显优于金字塔、经典、自监督、轻量级和扩散模型。族内不同检查点差异与族间差异相当或更大，说明训练课程和配方与架构同样重要。合成排名与真实性能呈中等相关的显著一致性，Spearman rho=0.63，但头部排名不完全一致。微调可显著降低保持无人机区域误差最高 37%，并改善真实视频中的无人机定位。
AI.conclusion: FlyingDrones 为远距离无人机光流估计提供了可控、密集标注、面向小目标的基准和归一化评测协议；研究揭示了高分辨率下模型架构、训练策略与域适应之间的关系，说明合成基准具有实用诊断和迁移价值，但不能完全替代真实测试。

title: AffineGS: Unlocking Accurate Geometry in 3DGS via Spatially Varying Affine Rectification
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become the leading approach for photorealistic novel view synthesis, yet its geometric accuracy lags behind its visual quality. Existing depth-guided methods attempt to resolve this by regularizing the optimization with monocular depth priors, typically using a single global scale-and-shift alignment. Crucially, we discover a fundamental flaw in this assumption: modern monocular depth networks systematically exhibit region-dependent, piecewise-linear distortions. This discovery invalidates standard global alignment strategies, which warp scene geometry by enforcing a single transform. To address this, we introduce a spatially varying affine rectification model that corrects monocular disparity into consistent metric depth using regionally smooth, edge-aware fields. We further derive a normal-aware regularizer that uses spatial gradients to couple the rectified disparity with 3DGS depth and normals. Across diverse experimental settings, our sensor-free method shows strong photometric quality of Gaussian Splatting while substantially improving geometric accuracy and outperforming state-of-the art geometry-focused methods.
comment: Accpeted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出一种无需传感器、基于空间变化仿射校正和法线感知正则的单目深度先验优化方法，用于提升3D Gaussian Splatting的几何精度，同时保持其高质量新视角合成效果。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting在照片级真实感的新视角合成方面表现突出，但几何精度明显落后于视觉质量。现有深度引导方法通常依赖单目深度先验，并使用全局尺度与偏移对齐进行优化约束。作者发现现代单目深度网络存在区域依赖、分段线性的系统性畸变，因此单一全局对齐假设不成立，容易导致场景几何被扭曲。
AI.method: 方法首先引入空间变化的仿射校正模型，通过区域平滑且边缘感知的场，将单目视差转换为一致的度量深度；随后进一步推导法线感知正则项，利用空间梯度建立校正后的视差与3DGS渲染深度及表面法线之间的耦合约束。
AI.result: 在多种实验设置下，该方法无需额外传感器即可保持Gaussian Splatting的光度质量和新视角合成能力，同时显著提升几何精度，并优于当前以几何为重点的先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了单目深度先验在全局对齐中的根本缺陷，证明局部化、空间变化的深度校正与法线感知约束能够有效缓解3DGS几何失真，为照片级真实感渲染与高精度几何恢复的结合提供了可行路径。

title: Selective Event Evidence and Persistent Temporal Priors for Event-Based Point Tracking
summary: Event cameras enable tracking under fast motion and challenging illumination. However, stable long-term point tracking remains challenging: event activity is sparse and varies with scene content and motion, complicating correspondence, while trajectory estimates can drift over long sequences. Together, these challenges motivate a tracker that selectively uses informative event evidence and retains trajectory constraints across temporal windows. We propose Selective Event Evidence and Persistent Temporal Priors (SEPT), an event-only framework for tracking any point (TAP) over long sequences. SEPT introduces two complementary modules: Task-Adaptive Event Evidence Modulation (TEEM) and Persistent Trajectory Prior (PTP). Using only tracking supervision, TEEM learns a bounded reliability field that weights the event tensor across space, time, and channels before feature extraction. PTP carries geometric information across overlapping windows by marginalizing a fixed local quadratic trajectory model with a Schur complement. Its visibility-aware correction refines overlap coordinates, while a clipped terminal velocity initializes coordinates at newly exposed timestamps. SEPT builds on the ETAP architecture. SEPT is trained exclusively on synthetic EventKubric data and evaluated on five datasets across TAP and feature tracking. Results show that SEPT outperforms the retrained ETAP baseline in average Jaccard for TAP and in feature age and expected feature age for feature tracking; it also surpasses several methods combining event and frame inputs on EC and EDS. The source code is publicly available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SEPT 事件相机点跟踪框架，通过选择性加权事件证据和跨时间窗口持久化轨迹先验，缓解事件稀疏、对应困难和长序列漂移问题，实现更稳定的长期任意点跟踪。
AI.motivation: 事件相机适合高速运动和复杂光照场景，但其事件活动稀疏且随场景内容与运动变化，导致长时间任意点跟踪中的对应关系建立困难；此外，轨迹估计在长序列中容易漂移。因此需要一种能够优先利用有效事件证据、并在不同时间窗口间保持轨迹约束的跟踪方法。
AI.method: 作者提出 Selective Event Evidence and Persistent Temporal Priors（SEPT），一种仅使用事件流的长期跟踪任意点（TAP）框架，并基于 ETAP 架构构建。SEPT 包含两个互补模块：一是 Task-Adaptive Event Evidence Modulation（TEEM），仅利用跟踪监督学习任务自适应、有界可靠性场，在特征提取前对事件张量的空间、时间和通道维度进行加权，以抑制不可靠事件并增强有效证据；二是 Persistent Trajectory Prior（PTP），通过 Schur 补边缘化固定局部二次轨迹模型，在重叠时间窗口间持久传播几何轨迹信息，并用可见性感知的校正精修重叠坐标、用截断终端速度初始化新暴露时刻的坐标。模型仅在合成 EventKubric 数据上训练。
AI.result: 在 TAP 和特征跟踪任务上，SEPT 在五个数据集上进行了评估。结果显示，相比重新训练的 ETAP 基线，SEPT 在 TAP 的平均 Jaccard 指标上更优，并在特征跟踪的特征寿命与期望特征寿命指标上取得提升；同时，SEPT 在 EC 和 EDS 上超越了多种结合事件与图像帧输入的方法。
AI.conclusion: SEPT 通过可靠事件证据选择和持久化轨迹先验建模，有效缓解了事件相机长期点跟踪中的稀疏对应与轨迹漂移问题。仅依赖事件输入并在合成数据上训练即可跨多个真实或不同数据集取得稳定性能，说明其具有良好的泛化性和实用潜力；开源代码进一步提升可复现性与后续研究价值。

title: Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck for Multimodal Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Multimodal self-supervised learning is challenged by heterogeneity, unequal informativeness, and complex information interactions across multimodal data sources such as images, text, audio, and tabular data. While contrastive methods effectively align shared semantics, they typically rely on strong multi-view redundancy assumptions, overlooking modality-specific and synergistic information, thus leading to suboptimal representations. We propose the Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck (MIIB), a principled framework grounded in Partial Information Decomposition that explicitly encodes redundant, unique, and synergistic information within multimodal interactions. MIIB employs a dual-path model architecture for modality-specific encoding and multimodal fusion, optimized using surrogate tractable entropy-based objectives that enforce minimal sufficient representations without requiring explicit mutual information estimation. By leveraging variational bounds and score-based entropy estimation, MIIB efficiently captures complex cross-modal interactions while suppressing superfluous information. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art multimodal self-supervised methods. Code is available at this https URL.
comment: 15 pages, 3-page supplementary material provided as an ancillary file. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)

AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态信息交互瓶颈（MIIB），通过部分信息分解显式建模多模态数据中的冗余、唯一和协同信息，以学习更充分且紧凑的多模态表征。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态自监督方法，尤其是对比学习，通常假设不同模态之间存在强冗余信息，并主要对齐共享语义，容易忽略模态特异性信息和跨模态协同信息，导致表征能力不足；同时多模态数据还存在异质性和信息量不均等问题。
AI.method: MIIB以部分信息分解为理论基础，设计双路径模型：一方面进行模态特定编码以保留唯一信息，另一方面进行多模态融合以刻画冗余与协同信息。训练采用可处理的熵相关代理目标和变分界、score-based熵估计，在不显式估计互信息的情况下实现最小充分表征并抑制无关信息。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，MIIB相比现有先进的多模态自监督方法能够取得一致的性能提升，说明该框架能够更有效地建模复杂跨模态信息交互。
AI.conclusion: MIIB通过将部分信息分解引入多模态自监督学习，同时考虑冗余、唯一和协同信息，提供了比传统对比式多模态表征学习更原则化且更具表达力的瓶颈建模思路。

title: BiGrounder: Bidirectional Training Unlocks the Potential of GUI Grounding
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding aims to map natural language instructions to precise operational coordinates, serving as a critical task for autonomous agent interaction. Current approaches formalize GUI grounding as predicting action-coordinate pairs from instructions, with end-to-end training supervised solely by final coordinates. Training datasets typically provide only a small number of descriptions per target coordinate, whereas real-world scenarios involve a much larger set of varied descriptions for the same target, which limits robustness to linguistic variation. While recent GUI grounding paradigms have begun employing reinforcement learning to enhance localization accuracy, models with limited exploratory capability before reinforcement yield constrained improvements even with identical training data during the reinforcement phase. To overcome these limitations, we propose a bidirectional reward paradigm that enables model self-reinforcement. During SFT, bidirectional training equips the model to generate action descriptions from target coordinates. During RL, the model samples semantically consistent instruction variations on-policy and grounds each variation back to its target. A cycle-consistency gate couples semantic quality to grounding success, turning the model's own instruction policy into a source of continually refreshed reinforcement trajectories. Our 4B-parameter model achieves competitive accuracy across five grounding benchmarks in our evaluation, indicating the effectiveness of the proposed training paradigm. this https URL

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种面向 GUI grounding 的双向奖励自强化训练范式：SFT 阶段让模型同时学习“指令→坐标”和“坐标→指令”，RL 阶段由模型生成指令变体并重新 grounding 回目标坐标，通过循环一致性门控产生持续、有效的强化学习轨迹。4B 模型在五个基准上取得有竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 方法通常只依赖少量“指令—目标坐标”配对进行端到端监督，难以覆盖真实场景中同一目标对应的丰富语言表达；近期强化学习方法虽能提升定位精度，但如果模型前期探索能力有限，在相同训练数据下 RL 增益受限。
AI.method: 论文提出双向奖励范式：首先，在 SFT 阶段进行双向训练，使模型能够根据目标坐标反向生成动作描述；随后，在 RL 阶段让模型在线采样语义一致的指令变体，并将每个变体重新 grounding 回原始目标坐标；通过 cycle-consistency gate 将语义一致性与 grounding 成功率耦合，使模型自身的指令生成策略不断产生新的强化学习轨迹，从而实现自我强化。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法训练出的 4B 参数模型在五个 GUI grounding 基准评测中均取得有竞争力的准确率，验证了双向奖励与循环一致性自强化训练范式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 双向生成与循环一致性可显著增强 GUI grounding 模型的语言鲁棒性和 RL 探索有效性，为少配对、语言表达多样的 GUI 任务提供了一种不依赖外部大规模指令数据的自我强化训练思路。

title: Rain Beyond Streaks: Cascaded Realistic Rain and Wet Surface Synthesis via Scene Priors
summary: Realistic rain synthesis is a persistent challenge for vision systems operating in adverse weather. Existing methods primarily focus on generating rain streaks, often neglecting consequent surface effects such as reflections and puddles, which are critical for perceptual realism and robustness of downstream vision tasks. We introduce CascadeRS, a rain synthesis framework that leverages depth and segmentation priors to render scene-consistent rain and surface effects. In addition to rain streaks, CascadeRS produces reflections and puddles aligned with scene semantics through a physics-inspired zero-shot, controllable generative pipeline. It produces photorealistic rainy urban scenes, with high perceptual realism, which we validate qualitatively with an extensive user study and quantitatively. We produce the Cityscapes-CascadeRS dataset, to study downstream task performance under real rainy conditions. Our results establish CascadeRS as a scalable and realistic rain-generation framework for evaluating and enhancing the robustness of vision in adverse rainy weather. Code and dataset are available via this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出CascadeRS，一种利用深度与语义分割先验生成真实雨天场景的框架，不仅合成雨线，还生成与场景一致的反射和水坑等表面效应，并构建Cityscapes-CascadeRS数据集用于评估视觉系统在雨天下游任务中的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现实雨场景合成对恶劣天气下的视觉系统非常重要，但现有方法多只关注雨线，忽略反射、水坑等表面效应，导致感知真实性和下游任务鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: CascadeRS引入深度和分割先验，采用受物理启发的零样本、可控生成管线，协同渲染雨线、水面反射和水坑，使其与场景语义和结构保持一致，从而生成真实感雨景。
AI.result: 该方法能够生成照片级真实的城市雨景，在用户研究和定量评估中表现出较高感知真实度，并基于Cityscapes-CascadeRS数据集观察到雨天下游视觉任务性能的变化。
AI.conclusion: CascadeRS为恶劣天气下视觉系统提供了可扩展、真实的雨景生成工具，可用于评估和增强视觉模型在雨天的鲁棒性。

title: Self-Supervised Diffusion Models for Handwritten Signature Verification via Ruin Reconstruction
summary: Handwritten signature verification (HSV) is a critical biometric technique in legal and forensic authentication, whose efficacy hinges on the discriminability of signature representations. Current HSV methods predominantly adopt supervised learning to enhance representation quality, leaving self-supervised learning largely unexplored. We propose \emph{SigDiffuser}, a diffusion-based self-supervised framework for signature representation and verification. At its core, \emph{SigDiffuser} introduces a novel pretext task termed \emph{Reconstruction from Ruins (RFR)}, which deliberately ``ruins'' signatures through severe crumpling, obliterating their structural integrity and writing styles. A visual encoder is employed to capture crucial handwriting patterns from intact signature regions, guiding the denoiser to reconstruct the ``ruined'' portions and learning meaningful representations. Additionally, we introduce a \emph{pyramidal feature aggregation module (PFAM)} to bridge the visual encoder and denoiser, enhancing representation quality via hierarchical aggregation and modulation. Extensive experiments on multilingual signature datasets demonstrate that \emph{SigDiffuser} significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art SSL methods and HSV models. We further show that increasing the crumpling severity on signatures effectively improves representation quality. Notably, our work demonstrates that extreme destruction, coupled with self-supervised diffusion models, can yield superior signature representation compared to traditional mild deformations, paving new avenues for HSV and other biometric domains. Code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 SigDiffuser，一种基于扩散模型的自监督手写签名表示与验证框架，通过“从残骸中重建”（RFR）任务利用极端破坏-重建机制学习更具判别性的签名特征，在验证任务上显著优于现有自监督学习和手写签名验证方法。
AI.motivation: 手写签名验证在法律和司法鉴定中具有重要作用，但其性能依赖签名表示的可区分性。现有方法主要依赖有监督学习，自监督学习在该领域仍缺乏探索。如何在不依赖大量标注的情况下学习鲁棒、细粒度、包含笔迹风格与结构特征的签名表示，是核心问题。
AI.method: SigDiffuser 采用扩散式自监督框架。其核心预训练任务为 Reconstruction from Ruins（RFR），即通过对签名进行严重褶皱/破坏，刻意消除其结构完整性和书写风格，使模型从“残破”签名中恢复原始信息。视觉编码器从完整签名区域中提取关键笔迹模式，并引导去噪器重建被破坏的部分，从而学习有意义的表示。此外，引入金字塔特征聚合模块（PFAM），桥接视觉编码器与去噪器，通过层级特征聚合和调制增强表示质量。
AI.result: 在多语言签名数据集上的大量实验表明，SigDiffuser 显著优于当前最先进的自监督学习方法和手写签名验证模型。研究还发现，随着签名破坏程度增加，模型学习到的签名表示质量进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明，极端破坏结合扩散式自监督学习可以获得优于传统轻度形变增强的签名表示。SigDiffuser 为手写签名验证以及更广泛的生物特征识别任务提供了新的自监督建模范式，并计划开源代码。

title: MV-Sign: Multi-View 3D Motion Integration and Enhanced Text-to-Motion Conditioning for Sign Language Production
summary: Sign language production (SLP) aims to generate appropriate sign language motion from spoken language text. However, current 3D SLP methods suffer from noisy supervision and weak text conditioning. Specifically, these methods typically rely on pseudo-3D motion data fitted from single-view frontal videos, which introduces severe self-occlusion and loses fine-grained hand details, ultimately degrading downstream production. To overcome these limitations, we propose a comprehensive framework that jointly integrates multi-view 3D motion data and optimizes the text-conditioning pathway. First, we introduce How2Sign-MV3D, a high-fidelity dataset constructed via a novel cross-view curation pipeline that fuses multi-view estimates to resolve occlusions and filter non-signing segments. Second, we design a robust SLP model incorporating a sign-aware spatio-temporal VQ-VAE (ST-VQVAE) for joint body-hand tokenization, a pseudo-gloss adapter, and keyframe-aware retrieval to enhance text-to-motion alignment. Evaluated on the How2Sign benchmark, our framework reduces body and hand DTW-PA-JPE by 32.8% and 20.9% respectively compared to the state-of-the-art. Finally, we release two new high-quality 3D datasets, ASLCitizen-3D and MM-WAuslan-MV3D, alongside SGNify-MV as a multi-view video benchmark to support broader community research.

title: STAG-Net: Structure-Aware Attention over Landmark Groups for Lightweight Head Pose Estimation
summary: Head pose estimation is important for human computer interaction and driver monitoring, but many image based methods remain too costly for resource constrained deployment. We propose STAG-Net, a structure-aware attention over landmark groups for lightweight head Pose estimation that estimates head pose from facial landmarks using movement aware selection, spatial clustering, compact DeepSet encoders, self attention, and a global geometry descriptor. We develop variants using FaceMesh and Face Alignment Network landmarks and evaluate them under cross dataset and subject independent protocols on 300W-LP, AFLW2000, and BIWI. STAG-Net achieves the lowest mean absolute error among all compared landmark based methods in every evaluated setting. On BIWI frames with valid detections, the FAN variant also records the lowest overall error among all compared methods, reaching $3.51^\circ$ under cross dataset evaluation and $2.39^\circ$ under subject independent evaluation. The regressors use only 0.012 to 0.043 million parameters and 24.1 to 83.6 thousand FLOPs, about three orders of magnitude fewer FLOPs than FSA-Net. Despite including landmark extraction and regression, the FaceMesh pipeline reaches 322.9 frames per second on a Tesla T4 GPU, nearly twice the 164.5 frames per second of the fastest measured image based baseline, and 111.0 frames per second on CPU. After normalization by dataset size, STAG-Net processes training samples seven to eight times faster than FSA-Net and more than one hundred times faster than HopeNet and TokenHPE, while complete training finishes within 28 minutes. These results show that STAG-Net combines leading landmark based accuracy with substantially lower training and inference cost.

AI.tldr: STAG-Net是一种基于面部关键点、面向轻量级头姿估计的结构感知注意力方法，通过关键点分组、空间聚簇、紧凑DeepSet编码、自注意力和全局几何描述实现高精度且低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 头姿估计对人机交互和驾驶员监控很重要，但许多基于图像的方法计算成本高，难以在资源受限设备上部署，因此需要兼顾精度、推理速度和训练效率的轻量级方案。
AI.method: 作者提出STAG-Net，从面部关键点估计头姿。方法包括运动感知选择、空间聚类、紧凑DeepSet编码器、自注意力机制和全局几何描述符。实验开发了基于FaceMesh和Face Alignment Network（FAN）关键点的变体，并在300W-LP、AFLW2000和BIWI数据集上采用跨数据集和主体无关协议进行评估。

title: THG-Omni: Traceable Human-Centric Graph Supervision for Video Reasoning
summary: Omni-modal models can answer questions about video, but their predictions rarely show which participant, event, or interval supports an answer. Moreover, answer-level supervision alone does not teach a model to interpret structured video evidence. To systematically mitigate this issue, we present THG-Omni, a human-centric graph-supervision framework that links Segment Anything Model~3 participant tracks with temporally grounded Qwen3-VL annotations. Candidate semantic claims are checked against the source video and available audio before they are used to construct training questions, while track geometry provides explicit spatial and temporal supervision. The resulting questions teach an omni-modal reasoning model to interpret participant attributes, actions, affect, interactions, and their timing from a structured graph. At inference, THG-Omni uses a predicted graph constructed from the evaluation video. Experiments on IntentBench show consistent improvements over the unadapted backbone across social reasoning, emotion understanding, and deception perception. On NExT-QA, THG-Omni achieves 89.54\% accuracy with the matched graph, compared with 85.10\% without graph input. Further validation experiments show that compact graph input achieves 78.22\% accuracy, compared with 78.02\% using the full graph and 77.58\% without graph input. A complementary diagnostic demonstrates that the predicted graph preserves evidence useful for answering questions even without the source video and audio. Together, these findings show that THG-Omni improves human-centric video reasoning while grounding its evidence in identifiable participants and events. Our codes are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: THG-Omni 是一个以人为中心的图监督框架，通过将 Segment Anything Model 3 的人物轨迹与 Qwen3-VL 的时间接地标注相结合，使全模态视频模型不仅能回答问题，还能基于可追踪的参与者、事件和时间区间提供可解释的证据支持。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态模型虽然能够回答视频相关问题，但其预测通常不能说明答案由哪些人物、事件或时间片段支持；仅依赖答案层面的监督也难以让模型学会解读结构化的视频证据。
AI.method: 该工作将 SAM3 追踪得到的人物轨迹与 Qwen3-VL 生成的时间对齐标注构建成图结构，并在利用候选语义断言前对照源视频和音频进行验证，随后基于图中的人物属性、动作、情绪、交互及其时间信息构造训练问题。模型在推理时使用从评测视频中预测得到的图结构作为输入。
AI.result: 在 IntentBench 上，THG-Omni 相较于未适配主干模型，在社交推理、情绪理解和欺骗感知等任务上均有一致提升。在 NExT-QA 上，匹配图输入达到 89.54%，高于无图输入的 85.10%；进一步实验中，紧凑图输入为 78.22%，接近全图输入的 78.02% 并优于无图输入的 77.58%。诊断实验还表明，预测图即使不包含原始视频和音频，也保留了可用于回答问题的证据。
AI.conclusion: THG-Omni 能提升以人为中心的视频推理能力，并使模型答案建立在可识别的人物和事件之上，从而增强全模态视频理解的可解释性与证据接地性。

title: PVDepth: Panoramic Video Depth Estimation via Geometry-Aware Spatiotemporal Adaptation
summary: Panoramic video depth estimation is pivotal for applications such as Virtual Reality and World Models. However, advancements in this field are impeded by two primary obstacles: the scarcity of large-scale training data and the unique spatiotemporal challenges of Equirectangular Projection (ERP), which hinder the direct transfer of perspective models. In this paper, we first present PanoCARLA, a large-scale synthetic RGB-D panoramic video dataset, featuring natural motion trajectories and drone-like roaming perspectives. Building on this foundation, we propose PVDepth, an end-to-end framework adapted from perspective video depth models. To tackle ERP-specific geometric distortions and consequent non-linear temporal dynamics, we introduce two core mechanisms: (1) A Progressive Sphere-aware Noise Initialization strategy that anneals the noise distribution from planar to spherical, guiding the model to adapt to non-uniform information density; and (2) A Cube-rectified Temporal Modeling module that incorporates an auxiliary cubemap temporal branch to rectify non-linear temporal dynamics in the ERP domain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PVDepth achieves superior performance, generating geometrically accurate and temporally consistent depth sequences. Code and data will be released at https:// this http URL.

title: Structure from Collision via Hypothesis-Space Reasoning
summary: Knowledge of the hidden interior structure of an object, including the presence and location of cavities, is essential for predictive simulation, robotic manipulation, and nondestructive inspection. However, such cavities leave no direct signature on the static visible surface, making collision-induced deformation one of the few cues used to infer their presence. Structure from Collision (SfC) addresses this problem by recovering the hidden interior structure of an object from multiview observations of a collision event. SfC is challenging for two reasons: hidden cavities are only indirectly observable through surface motion, and voids correspond to the absence of material, making direct optimization using standard density representations difficult. The density-based SfC baseline inherits both difficulties. Surface-matching gradients do not directly indicate the cavity location, while density gradients can be weak or uninformative inside or near void regions. Therefore, we reformulate SfC as hypothesis-space reasoning, representing hidden cavities as explicit structural hypotheses whose variables encode available structural assumptions rather than relying on implicit density updates. A global stage performs gradient-free optimization over this hypothesis space using forward-only material point method (MPM) simulation. A local stage then refines the selected hypothesis as a Lagrangian particle system through gradient-based optimization using differentiable MPM simulation. On the SfC benchmark, our method improves hidden-structure reconstruction and future prediction over the density-based SfC baseline. Interior-topology stress tests and robustness analyses characterize its scope and limitations. The project page is available at this https URL.
