AI.tldr: 论文提出一种将碰撞诱发形变转化为假设空间推理的方法，从多视角碰撞观测中恢复物体内部的隐藏空腔结构。
AI.motivation: 物体内部的隐藏空腔不会在静态可见表面留下直接线索，却对预测性模拟、机器人操作和无损检测至关重要。碰撞诱发的表面形变是少数可用于推断空腔存在的视觉线索。现有基于密度的结构重建方法存在两个难点：一是表面匹配梯度不能直接指示空腔位置，二是空腔对应材料缺失区域，标准密度表示在 void 附近梯度弱或缺乏判别性。
AI.method: 将 Structure from Collision 重新表述为假设空间推理，把隐藏空腔表示为显式结构假设，其变量编码可用的结构先验，而不是依赖隐式密度更新。方法分为两个阶段：全局阶段使用仅前向的材料点法模拟，在假设空间中进行无梯度优化以筛选候选空腔结构；局部阶段将选定假设立即细化为拉格朗日粒子系统，并通过可微 MPM 进行基于梯度的优化，以进一步估计几何和动力学一致性。
AI.result: 在 SfC 基准上，该方法相较基于密度的 SfC 基线提升了隐藏结构重建和未来预测性能。研究还通过内部拓扑压力测试和鲁棒性分析刻画了方法适用范围与局限。
AI.conclusion: 用显式假设空间表示隐藏空腔，可规避密度表示在 void 区域梯度不足和位置线索间接的问题；结合全局无梯度搜索与局部可微优化，能够更有效地从碰撞观测中恢复物体内部结构并提升预测能力。

title: XM4D: 4D Reconstruction through Certifiable Geometric Optimization
summary: Accurate 4D reconstruction remains challenging: jointly estimating camera motion, scene geometry, and non-rigid deformation entails highly nonconvex optimization, making global optimality difficult to guarantee. We present XM4D, a framework for accurate and efficient 4D reconstruction built upon certifiably globally optimal geometric optimization. By separating the estimation of camera motion from non-rigid deformation, we formulate both stages as structured quadratically constrained quadratic programs (QCQP) that admit semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxations and verifiable global optimality certificates. For camera motion estimation, we lift static point tracks into 3D using foundational depth prediction models and formulate a scaled bundle adjustment problem that jointly estimates camera poses, depth scales, and static landmarks. By analytically eliminating translations and landmarks, we reduce the problem to a QCQP over scaled rotations. For non-rigid reconstruction, we represent dynamic motion using an embedded deformation graph (EDG) and show that its tracking, rigidity, and temporal regularization objectives similarly reduce to a rotation-only QCQP. Both problems admit SDP relaxations that we solve efficiently with a GPU-accelerated Burer-Monteiro solver based on Riemannian optimization. The recovered geometry further initializes dynamic Gaussian splatting for photometric refinement. Extensive experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate accurate camera motion estimation on both static and dynamic scenes, efficient optimization that scales to thousands of frames, and state-of-the-art novel-view rendering quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 XM4D，一种面向高精度、高效 4D 重建的可验证全局最优几何优化框架。其核心是将相机运动估计与非刚性形变估计解耦，并把二者分别转化为仅关于旋转的结构化二次约束二次规划（QCQP），再通过半定规划（SDP）松弛和 GPU 加速的黎曼优化求解，从而获得具有全局最优性证书的 4D 重建结果，并进一步用于动态高斯溅射的光度细化。
AI.motivation: 准确进行 4D 重建需要同时估计相机运动、场景几何和非刚性形变，这导致高度非凸的联合优化问题，容易陷入局部最优且难以保证全局最优性。已有方法虽然可利用深度先验、变形图或高斯溅射等技术提升重建质量，但在复杂动态场景中仍面临优化稳定性不足、可扩展性有限以及全局最优性难以验证等问题。因此，作者希望构建一种能够将相机运动与形变解耦、并将关键优化子问题转化为可验证全局最优形式的框架，以提升 4D 重建的精度、效率和可靠性。
AI.method: XM4D 将 4D 重建分为相机运动估计和非刚性形变重建两个阶段，并分别构造为可半定规划松弛的 QCQP 问题。第一阶段中，作者利用基础深度预测模型将静态点轨迹提升到三维空间，形成同时估计相机位姿、深度尺度和静态地标点的尺度化捆绑调整问题；随后解析消除平移和地标变量，将问题归约为仅包含尺度化旋转的 QCQP。第二阶段中，动态形变用嵌入变形图（EDG）表示，其跟踪项、刚性项和时间正则项同样被归约为旋转主导的 QCQP。两类 QCQP 均可通过 SDP 松弛获得全局最优性证书，并采用基于黎曼优化的 GPU 加速 Burer–Monteiro 求解器高效求解。最后，由几何恢复结果初始化动态高斯溅射，以进行光度层面的细化渲染。
AI.result: 在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在静态与动态场景中均能实现准确的相机运动估计，并具备可扩展到数千帧序列的高效优化能力。同时，借助可验证全局最优的几何初始化，该方法在新视角渲染质量上取得了先进（state-of-the-art）表现，验证了 XM4D 在精度、效率和重建质量方面的综合优势。
AI.conclusion: XM4D 证明了通过解耦相机运动与非刚性形变，并将关键估计问题归约为可求解且可验证的 QCQP/SDP 优化形式，可以在保证全局最优性的同时实现高效准确的 4D 重建。该方法为复杂动态场景中的稳定几何估计提供了可验证优化框架，并通过几何先验与高斯溅射的结合进一步提升了渲染质量。

title: StitchEdit: Stitching Depth Priors into Image Editors via Per-Layer Gradient Probing
summary: Text-guided image editing with diffusion models struggles with spatial edits (e.g. manipulating objects, changing viewpoints, manipulating occlusions) that depend on the 3D structure understanding of a scene. Marigold and follow-up work demonstrate that a pretrained diffusion backbone already harbors strong geometric priors that can be activated for depth estimation, yet how to redirect these priors toward editing remains unresolved. Through per-layer gradient probing, we discover that the editing and depth objectives are compatible in early transformer layers but actively conflict in late layers, explaining why naive depth-conditioned editing either ignores geometry or degrades visual quality. We present StitchEdit, which first activates the backbone's geometric capability via a lightweight depth-denoising adapter, then selectively fine-tunes this adapter for editing using a probe-guided per-layer learning rate schedule that preserves depth knowledge where it helps and prunes it where it conflicts. On the proposed StitchEditBench, a benchmark of 150 geometry-dependent edits spanning spatial transformation, occlusion manipulation, and viewpoint change, StitchEdit consistently surpasses both instruction-based and depth-conditioned baselines on perceptual quality and geometric fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 StitchEdit，针对文本引导扩散图像编辑中空间/三维结构编辑困难的问题，利用预训练扩散模型中已有的几何先验，并通过逐层梯度探测发现编辑目标与深度目标在浅层兼容、深层冲突，进而采用深度去噪适配器与探测引导的逐层学习率调度实现几何一致的图像编辑，同时建立包含 150 个几何依赖编辑的 StitchEditBench 评测。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导扩散模型在需要 3D 结构理解的空间编辑任务中表现不足，例如物体移动、视角变化、遮挡处理等。Marigold 等研究已表明预训练扩散骨干内部蕴含较强几何先验，可用于深度估计，但如何将这些几何先验有效迁移并重新导向图像编辑仍缺乏清晰方法。直接以深度条件引导编辑往往要么忽略几何，要么损害视觉质量，原因尚未被充分解释。
AI.method: 作者首先通过逐层梯度探测分析编辑目标与深度优化目标在扩散 Transformer 不同层中的相互作用，发现两者在早期 Transformer 层中兼容，而在后期层中产生主动冲突。基于该发现，提出 StitchEdit：先通过轻量级深度去噪适配器激活扩散骨干中的几何能力；再对适配器进行面向编辑的选择性微调，并使用探测引导的逐层学习率调度，在有利于编辑的层保留深度知识，在造成冲突的层抑制或“剪除”深度优化影响，从而兼顾几何一致性和视觉质量。
AI.result: 在提出的 StitchEditBench 上，该基准覆盖空间变换、遮挡操作和视角变化共 150 个几何依赖编辑样本。实验结果显示，StitchEdit 在感知质量和几何保真度两方面均稳定优于基于指令的编辑基线以及深度条件编辑基线。
AI.conclusion: 预训练扩散模型内部已有可利用的几何先验，但编辑与深度任务在不同网络层中存在层级依赖冲突；通过梯度探测指导的层级选择性优化，可以更有效地将几何先验转化为高质量空间编辑能力。StitchEdit 和 StitchEditBench 为面向三维结构一致的文本引导图像编辑提供了新的方法路径和评测基准。

title: WAM-Sim0.1: World Anchored Memory Meets Online RL for Consistent and Realistic Driving Simulation
summary: Autoregressive driving world models systematically suffer from structural drift, identity drift, and quality decay over long rollout horizons due to transient conditioning signals that lack persistent state. We present WAM-Sim, a driving world model anchored by a persistent hierarchical memory and optimized via online flow-matching RL. WAM-Sim structures persistent context across three temporal and semantic scales: pose-aligned structural tokens encoding persistent road topology, read-only scene tokens supplying geolocated background appearance, and write-once instance tokens preserving individual traffic participant identities across occlusions and chunk boundaries. To restore visual sharpness and physical plausibility degraded by multi-scale conditioning, we introduce an online post-training framework that optimizes self-generated rollouts via flow-matching RL guided by hierarchy-aligned visual rewards and a vision-language model physical judge. The invariant memory empirically confines policy optimization within the anchored context, helping suppress semantic collapse and reward hacking, while online RL systematically enforces physical commonsense and fine-grained visual fidelity. On the nuScenes benchmark, WAM-Sim achieves a superior generation fidelity (FID=3.47, FVD=25.72) and strong downstream perception performance (24.16 mAP, 71.23 road mIoU). On minute-scale rollouts of self-collected data, WAM-Sim substantially mitigates structural and identity drift, preserving high scene similarity and subject identity coherence across extended horizons. Project page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WAM-Sim，一个面向自动驾驶的长时程世界模型，通过持久化分层记忆与在线流匹配强化学习后训练，缓解自回归生成中的结构漂移、身份漂移和质量衰减，并在 nuScenes 及分钟级自采数据上取得更高生成保真度和更强下游感知性能。
AI.motivation: 自回归驾驶世界模型通常依赖短暂的条件信号，缺少持久状态，因此在长时间 rollout 中容易出现道路拓扑结构漂移、交通参与者身份丢失、视觉质量下降以及物理合理性不足等问题，难以支持分钟级连续仿真和下游感知任务。
AI.method: WAM-Sim 构建三层持久化上下文：1）与位姿对齐的结构化 token，用于表示道路拓扑和场景骨架；2）只读的场景 token，用于提供地理定位的背景外观；3）一次性写入的实例 token，用于在遮挡和分块边界之间保持交通参与者身份。针对多尺度条件输入导致的清晰度和物理合理性退化，作者提出在线后训练框架：模型生成 rollout，流匹配强化学习利用分层对齐视觉奖励和视觉语言模型物理评判进行优化。持久记忆还约束策略优化在已锚定上下文中进行，抑制语义坍塌和 reward hacking。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 基准上，WAM-Sim 达到 FID=3.47、FVD=25.72，并在下游感知任务中取得 24.16 mAP 和 71.23 road mIoU。在自采数据的分钟级长 rollout 中，该方法显著缓解结构漂移和身份漂移，保持较高场景相似度和主体身份一致性。
AI.conclusion: 持久化分层记忆与在线流匹配 RL 相结合，是提升自回归驾驶世界模型长时程稳定性、视觉质量和物理合理性的重要路径。WAM-Sim 证明，通过引入可保持的上下文状态和层次化奖励约束，可以有效改善长时间连续生成，并增强对下游感知任务的支持能力。

title: IDPrior: Decoupling Identity Generation from Facial Image Synthesis
summary: Large-scale identity-labeled face datasets are essential for training modern face recognition models, yet collecting and annotating such data is costly and raises privacy and ethical concerns. Existing synthetic face generation methods typically derive identities from predefined class labels, unconditional image generation, or predefined latent sampling strategies, without explicitly modeling the underlying distribution of facial identities. In this paper, we propose IDPrior, a two-stage framework that decouples identity generation from image synthesis. We first learn a diffusion prior in the embedding space of a pretrained face recognition model to model the distribution of facial identities and generate novel identity embeddings. These embeddings are then used to condition a pretrained identity-conditioned diffusion model (DM), enabling the synthesis of multiple images of the same identity. This modular design provides a scalable approach to identity generation while remaining compatible with existing and future identity-conditioned DMs. Experiments indicate that IDPrior generates diverse and well-separated identities while maintaining a closer correspondence to the distribution of authentic identities. Face recognition models trained on datasets generated using IDPrior-generated identities achieve competitive or improved performance compared with existing synthetic-data-based methods across multiple face verification benchmarks. Code and generated datasets are publicly available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出IDPrior，一种两阶段身份生成框架：先在人脸识别模型的嵌入空间中学习身份分布的扩散先验，再用生成的身份嵌入条件化预训练身份条件扩散模型合成同一身份的多张人脸图像。
AI.motivation: 大规模带身份标签的人脸数据对训练人脸识别模型至关重要，但采集与标注成本高，且涉及隐私与伦理问题。现有合成人脸方法通常依赖预定义类别标签、无条件图像生成或预定义潜变量采样，未能显式建模真实人脸身份分布，导致生成身份在多样性和分布真实性上存在不足。
AI.method: IDPrior采用模块化两阶段设计。第一阶段：利用预训练人脸识别模型得到的身份嵌入，训练一个嵌入空间中的扩散先验模型，学习真实人脸身份的潜在分布，并生成新的身份嵌入。第二阶段：将生成出的身份嵌入作为条件输入预训练的身份条件扩散模型，以合成同一身份下的多张人脸图像，从而实现身份生成与图像生成分离。
AI.result: 实验表明，IDPrior能够生成具有较高多样性、彼此分离且更贴近真实身份分布的合成身份。基于IDPrior生成身份构建的数据集用于训练人脸识别模型时，在多个身份验证基准上取得了与现有合成数据方法相当或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: IDPrior通过显式建模身份分布并将身份生成与图像合成分离，为可扩展、兼容现有和未来身份条件扩散模型的人脸数据生成提供了一种有效框架，有望降低大规模人脸数据获取成本并缓解隐私伦理问题。

title: Rotation Is Token-Blind: A Structural Criterion for Post-Training Quantization of Feed-Forward Geometry Transformers
summary: Feed-forward 3D models use Transformers to predict camera poses, depth, and structure in one pass, avoiding iterative multi-view optimization. Long sequences and deep attention incur high compute and memory costs, motivating Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) for deployment. Existing PTQ methods mainly suppress channel-wise outliers by smoothing or orthogonal rotation. Geometry Transformers introduce a different challenge: heterogeneous token types share one activation quantization grid. A few special tokens may exert high leverage over global outputs and be updated by only a subset of blocks. Token-blind transforms, which apply the same transformation to every token, reduce overall quantization error but cannot remove differentiated degradation across token types. We propose QMapAnything, a structure-aware PTQ framework. We cast floating-point-preserving rotation and smoothing as a token-blind reparameterization group, and prove that they yield common-mode gains while leaving relative token SNR unchanged. We introduce a statistic $\Gamma$ that combines a special token's quantization disadvantage and output leverage to predict whether differentiated bias correction is needed beyond rotation. Experiments on geometric benchmarks show that W4A8 closely matches full-precision performance. Under W8A8, peak memory falls by $2.2$--$3.1\times$ versus FP32, with up to $3.1\times$ speedup on real hardware. These results provide a principled and efficient approach to deploying feed-forward 3D reconstruction models in resource-constrained edges.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对前馈式3D重建Transformer模型的低比特部署问题，提出结构感知PTQ框架QMapAnything，通过区分不同token类型的量化误差与输出影响，实现接近全精度的W4A8性能，并在W8A8下显著降低显存和提升推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有PTQ方法主要处理通道级异常值，但几何Transformer中不同token类型共享同一激活量化网格，少数特殊token可能对全局输出具有更高杠杆作用，却只被部分模块更新，导致传统token-blind变换无法消除token类型间的差异化量化退化。
AI.method: 提出QMapAnything：将保持浮点精度的旋转和平滑统一视为token-blind重参数化群，证明其只能带来共同模式增益且不改变相对token SNR；进一步设计统计量Γ，结合特殊token的量化劣势和输出杠杆，判断是否需要在旋转之外进行差异化偏置修正。
AI.result: 在几何基准实验表明，W4A8量化能够接近全精度性能；W8A8配置下，相较FP32峰值内存降低2.2至3.1倍，在真实硬件上最高取得3.1倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为前馈3D重建模型在资源受限边缘端的高效部署提供了有理论依据且实用的PTQ方案，说明结构感知的token级分析优于仅依赖通道平滑或旋转的统一变换。

title: Bri3D: Bridging the Object-Scene Gap in Single-Image 3D Generation via Scene-Anchor
summary: Generating compositional 3D scenes from a single image requires recovering detailed object geometry and coherent spatial arrangements. Existing object-to-scene methods, including SAM3D and MIDI, extend object generation through image-context reasoning or inter-instance modeling. Coordinating objects remains challenging with limited scene-level supervision. Directly extending object-centric generators to entire scenes can degrade geometry and fail to preserve instance scale, orientation, and pose. We propose Bri3D, a framework bridging scene-level structural reasoning and object-level generative priors through instance-aware voxel scene anchors. Bri3D predicts a color-coded scene scaffold encoding coarse object geometry and spatial arrangements. Each instance is extracted as a scene anchor and refined into a pose-preserving, prior-compatible voxel support, enabling a frozen object generator to synthesize detailed textured geometry in the anchor-defined spatial reference. This coarse-to-fine design separates scene organization from object-scale detail synthesis, focusing scene-level training on spatial organization and anchor refinement while reusing pretrained object priors. Experiments demonstrate improvements in scene layout, object geometry, visual quality, and generalization. Bri3D predicts scene layouts efficiently; full scene generation is faster than SceneGen and SAM3D.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Bri3D，通过实例感知的体素场景锚点将场景级结构推理与物体级生成先验连接起来，从而从单张图像生成具有合理布局、几何质量和实例尺度/姿态一致性的组合式3D场景。
AI.motivation: 现有从单图生成组合式3D场景的方法多基于物体生成模型扩展，但场景级监督有限，物体间的协调困难；若直接将物体中心生成器扩展到整个场景，容易导致几何质量下降，并难以保持实例的尺度、朝向和姿态。
AI.method: Bri3D首先预测一个颜色编码的场景支架，用于编码粗粒度物体几何和空间布局；随后将每个实例提取为场景锚点，并细化为保持姿态且兼容先验的体素支撑区域；最后利用冻结的物体生成器在锚点定义的空间参考中生成带纹理的精细几何。该粗到细设计将场景组织与物体细节合成解耦，使场景级训练聚焦于空间组织和锚点优化，同时复用预训练物体先验。
AI.result: 实验表明，Bri3D在场景布局、物体几何、视觉质量和泛化能力方面均有提升；其场景布局预测效率较高，完整场景生成速度优于SceneGen和SAM3D。
AI.conclusion: Bri3D通过体素场景锚点和粗到细框架有效协调了场景级结构推理与物体级生成先验，为单图组合式3D场景生成提供了更稳定、高效且可泛化的方案。

title: Deformable Contact-Aware 3D Object Placement
summary: Current language-guided 3D object placement typically predicts a rigid 6-DoF pose, ignoring the physical reality that indoor placements are dictated by contact. Consequently, predicted poses often float, interpenetrate supports, or fail to deform soft surfaces. We propose Deformable Contact-Aware Placement (DCAP), a framework that reframes placement as a drop-to-equilibrium process. Rather than predicting a static pose, DCAP constructs a semantic release state that specifies the drop location, object scale, and deformable components, allowing a coupled rigid-deformable simulator to settle the object under gravity and friction. This explicitly separates semantic intent from physical realization. Evaluated on a benchmark of 2,063 prompt-asset-scene cases, DCAP significantly outperforms static baselines. On standard placements, it improves VLM Physics & Naturalness by 21.2 points and human preference by 26.5 points over the strongest raw rigid baseline, while reducing mean penetration depth by 72.3%. Compared to simulated rollout baselines, DCAP reduces residual speed by 72.1%. Ultimately, our results prove that physically accurate 3D placement requires modeling semantic intent and physical realization as strictly separate processes.

AI.tldr: 提出 DCAP，将语言引导的室内 3D 物体放置从直接预测刚性 6-DoF 位姿改为“语义释放状态 + 刚柔耦合仿真下落到平衡”的可形变接触感知放置框架，显著提升物理合理性、自然度和人类偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有语言引导 3D 物体放置方法通常预测静态刚性 6-DoF 位姿，忽略了室内放置本质上由接触、重力、摩擦和软表面形变决定，导致物体悬空、穿透支撑物或无法与可形变表面正确交互。
AI.method: 方法提出 Deformable Contact-Aware Placement（DCAP）：不直接预测最终静态位姿，而是构建语义释放状态，指定下落位置、物体尺度和可形变部件；随后使用刚柔耦合仿真器在重力和摩擦作用下将物体模拟到平衡状态，从而显式分离语义意图与物理实现。
AI.result: 在包含 2,063 个 prompt-asset-scene 案例的基准上，DCAP 显著优于静态基线：相比最强原始刚性基线，VLM Physics & Naturalness 提升 21.2 分，人类偏好提升 26.5 分，平均穿透深度降低 72.3%；相比仿真 rollout 基线，残余速度降低 72.1%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持：物理准确的 3D 放置需要把语义意图与物理实现严格分离，并通过接触、重力和可形变仿真来落地放置结果。

title: NutriVisRAG: Multimodal Exemplar Grounding for Nutrient Estimation with Vision-Language Models
summary: Diet is a major determinant of health, yet accurate dietary assessment from free-living meal images remains challenging. Existing retrieval-based Vision-Language Model (VLM) approaches to nutrient estimation typically rely on textual food representations, while, to our knowledge, direct grounding on visually similar annotated meals has not been investigated. We present NutriVisRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a vision encoder to retrieve similar meals with known nutritional annotations and provide them as multimodal in-context exemplars for VLM nutrient estimation at inference time, without task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluate NutriVisRAG across four datasets, four VLMs, three retrieval encoders, and two prompting strategies, including free-living meals from adults with insulin-treated diabetes, where carbohydrate estimates are compared against two dietitians' annotations. Across all 96 configurations (4 datasets x 4 VLMs x 3 retrieval encoders x 2 prompting strategies), NutriVisRAG reduced the primary estimation error in 56, with improvements more frequent under whole-meal (35/48) than per-item prompting (21/48). Across the evaluated configurations, the lowest NutriVisRAG error was below the best Vanilla error in 13 of 16 VLM--dataset pairs. For GPT-5.4-mini, under whole-meal prompting, the best-performing retrieval encoder for each dataset reduced the primary error on all four datasets relative to Vanilla, with reductions of 1.7--35.7%. Overall, our results show that grounding in multimodal exemplars comprising images and respective annotations can improve nutrient estimation at inference time without task-specific fine-tuning, although the benefits remain configuration-dependent.

AI.tldr: NutriVisRAG 是一种无需任务微调的检索增强生成框架，通过视觉编码器检索已标注营养信息的相似餐食图像，并将其作为多模态示例提供给视觉-语言模型（VLM），从而提升自由生活场景下餐食营养估计的准确性。
AI.motivation: 准确评估饮食对健康至关重要，但从自由生活餐食图像中进行营养估计仍然困难。现有基于检索的 VLM 营养估计方法通常依赖文本化的食物表示，而直接将视觉上相似的已标注餐食作为证据进行营养估计尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 作者提出 NutriVisRAG：在推理阶段使用视觉编码器检索带有营养标注的相似餐食图像，将检索到的图像及其对应营养标注作为多模态上下文示例输入 VLM，实现无需任务特定微调的营养估计。研究在 4 个数据集、4 个 VLM、3 种检索编码器和 2 种提示策略下进行评估，并包含接受胰岛素治疗的成人糖尿病患者的自由生活餐食，其中碳水化合物估计与两名营养师的标注进行比较。
AI.result: 在全部 96 种配置中，NutriVisRAG 在 56 种配置中降低了主要估计误差。整体餐食提示策略下改善更频繁（35/48），高于逐项食物提示策略（21/48）。在评估配置中，16 个 VLM-数据集组合里有 13 个组合中 NutriVisRAG 的最低误差低于最佳 Vanilla 基线误差。对于 GPT-5.4-mini，在整体餐食提示下，每个数据集上表现最佳的检索编码器相对 Vanilla 均降低了主要误差，降幅为 1.7%-35.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将图像和相应营养标注组成的多模态示例作为视觉证据引入 VLM 推理过程，能够在不进行任务特定微调的情况下改善营养估计，但其收益依赖于数据集、VLM、检索编码器和提示策略等配置选择。

title: ATHAAR: A Medieval Scientific Arabic Manuscript Dataset for Handwritten Text Recognition
summary: Despite recent progress in handwritten text recognition, medieval Arabic scientific manuscripts remain an open challenge for current vision-language models (VLMs) due to cursive ligatures, variable diacritization, and more importantly the lack of training data. This paper aims to address this gap, by proposing the first annotation guidelines dedicated to the transcription of scientific Arabic manuscripts inspired by textual criticism, a well-established approach to historical text editing. We then propose, ATHAAR, a new dataset manually annotated following this guideline. Unlike previous resources in the field, ATHAAR varies both witnesses of the same text, calligraphic styles, and content to deal with texts but also numerals. Relying on state-of-the-art VLMs, we finally design a set of experiments to study models transfer across scripts, chapters, and treatises. Our findings highlight the limitations of current systems when faced with the specificities of ancient scientific texts.

AI.tldr: 该研究面向中世纪阿拉伯科学手稿识别难题，提出了基于文本校勘学的阿拉伯科学手稿转录标注规范，并构建了包含多种书写样式、文本见证与数值内容的新数据集ATHAAR；通过评测现有视觉语言模型在跨字体、章节和论文上的迁移能力，发现当前模型仍难以胜任此类手稿任务。
AI.motivation: 中世纪阿拉伯科学手稿因连写合字、变音符标注不稳定且训练数据稀缺，对现有视觉语言模型构成开放挑战。该研究旨在通过系统化标注方法和专用数据集，缓解领域数据不足并评估模型迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出受文本校勘学启发的阿拉伯科学手稿转录标注指南；按照该指南人工构建ATHAAR数据集，涵盖同一文本的不同抄本见证、多种书法风格和科学数值内容；基于先进视觉语言模型设计实验，评估模型在跨脚本/字体、章节和论文之间的迁移表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有视觉语言模型在处理古代科学手稿的书法、标注和数值符号等特殊性方面存在明显局限。
AI.conclusion: 中世纪阿拉伯科学手稿转录识别仍需更适配领域特性的数据资源与模型设计；该工作通过标注规范和ATHAAR数据集为相关研究与评测提供了基础。

title: Towards Practical 20 kbps Generative Video Compression via Adaptive Tokenization and Entropy Modeling
summary: Video compression at ultra-low bitrates remains challenging due to the loss of perceptually important details under limited bit budgets. Recent generative video compression methods leverage pretrained video priors to improve perceptual quality and temporal coherence, but many follow a compress-then-generate paradigm, where generative priors are primarily exploited during reconstruction. Moreover, representations learned for generation and reconstruction are not inherently optimized for entropy coding. In this work, we propose \method, which adapts pretrained video representations into compression-oriented representations while preserving their reconstruction capability. Specifically, we adapt the pretrained causal video VAE of MiniMax-H3 into a discrete video tokenizer and develop a small autoregressive entropy model that captures local and global token dependencies, with grouped prediction for parallel decoding. To further improve coding efficiency, we jointly optimize the tokenizer and entropy model using a differentiable rate surrogate, allowing rate gradients to adapt token assignments toward lower coding costs while preserving reconstruction quality. Experiments on UVG, MCL-JCV, and HEVC Class B demonstrate superior perceptual rate--distortion performance, achieving BD-LPIPS savings of 82.2\%--87.5\% and BD-DISTS savings of 78.3\%--85.0\% relative to GLC-Video.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种面向压缩的预训练视频表征适配方法，将 MiniMax-H3 的因果视频 VAE 改造为离散视频 tokenizer，并用小型自回归熵模型与可微率代理联合优化，在超低码率下显著提升感知视频压缩效率。
AI.motivation: 超低码率视频压缩容易丢失感知重要细节；现有生成式视频压缩多采用“先压缩、后生成”范式，主要依赖生成先验做重建，但其表征并非原生为熵编码优化，导致压缩率和重建质量之间难以平衡。
AI.method: 方法核心包括：1）将预训练 causal video VAE 适配为离散视频 tokenizer，保留重建能力；2）设计小型自回归熵模型，建模局部与全局 token 依赖，并采用分组预测实现并行解码；3）引入可微分率代理，对 tokenizer 与熵模型联合优化，使 token 分配在降低码率成本的同时维持重建质量。
AI.result: 在 UVG、MCL-JCV 和 HEVC Class B 数据集上，该方法在感知率失真曲线上优于 GLC-Video，相对其取得 82.2%–87.5% 的 BD-LPIPS 节省和 78.3%–85.0% 的 BD-DISTS 节省。
AI.conclusion: 通过把预训练视频生成表征转化为压缩导向表征，并联合优化 tokenizer 与熵模型，可在超低码率下同时获得更高压缩效率、更强感知质量和更好的时序一致性，推动生成式视频压缩从“重建增强”走向“表征—编码协同优化”。

title: FreeOcc: Decoupling Ego-Motion for Efficient 4D Occupancy Forecasting via Continuous Flow Matching
summary: Current 4D occupancy world models use heavy cross-attention or deep recurrence to disentangle ego-motion from scene dynamics. This requires significant computational capacity. However, this effort is largely redundant since the ego-vehicle's intended future motion is provided by the downstream motion planner. We present FreeOcc, a lightweight continuous-time world model that introduces explicit $SE(2)$ geometric decoupling into a conditional flow-matching framework. By mathematically factoring out self-motion, we create a purely dynamic feature space. This space supports attention-free temporal fusion and allows physics-constrained ODEs to operate strictly on residual agent kinematics. To maximize deployment efficiency, FreeOcc introduces an uncertainty-aware blending mechanism. This routes well-observed voxels to a single-pass decoder, reserving the ODE solver exclusively for ambiguous, high-uncertainty regions. Requiring only 28.3M parameters-roughly 40% of comparable models-our optimal ensemble mode (FreeOcc-E) runs at 27 FPS. On nuScenes, FreeOcc achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance with a 0.47 m Near Field Chamfer Distance (NFCD) and 32.1% mIoU. Furthermore, the model transfers zero-shot to SemanticKITTI. It also proves highly robust, retaining 92.8% of its ideal mIoU under significant sensor packet loss and timestamp jitter.

AI.tldr: FreeOcc提出一种轻量级连续时间4D占用世界模型，通过显式SE(2)几何解耦将自车运动从场景动态中剥离，在条件流匹配框架中形成纯动态特征空间，并结合免注意力时序融合、物理约束ODE和不确定性感知混合机制，实现高效、鲁棒的占用预测。模型仅需28.3M参数、约27 FPS运行，在nuScenes上取得SOTA预测性能，并能零样本迁移到SemanticKITTI。
AI.motivation: 现有4D占用世界模型通常依赖重量级交叉注意力或深度循环结构来区分自车运动和场景动态，计算开销大。然而下游运动规划器已经能够提供自车未来意图运动，因此从占用世界模型中重复推断或分离自车运动是冗余的。论文旨在利用显式几何解耦减少不必要计算，使模型专注于场景中其他代理的动态变化，从而提升部署效率和鲁棒性。
AI.method: FreeOcc在条件流匹配框架中引入显式SE(2)几何解耦，将自车运动从特征空间中数学地分离出去，得到只描述场景变化的纯动态特征空间。该空间支持无需注意力机制的时序融合，并使物理约束ODE仅作用于其他交通代理的剩余运动学。为提升推理效率，模型进一步采用不确定性感知混合机制：对观测充分、不确定性低的体素使用单遍解码器处理，仅对高不确定性、观测模糊的区域调用ODE求解器。整体形成FreeOcc-E最优集成模式。
AI.result: FreeOcc仅需28.3M参数，约为可比模型的40%；最优集成模式FreeOcc-E达到27 FPS。在nuScenes上取得先进占用预测结果：Near Field Chamfer Distance为0.47 m，mIoU为32.1%。模型还可零样本迁移到SemanticKITTI。在显著传感器丢包和时间戳抖动条件下，仍能保留理想mIoU的92.8%，表现出较强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，利用下游规划器提供的自车运动信息，并通过显式SE(2)几何解耦将自车运动从占用世界模型中剥离，可显著降低模型复杂度。结合不确定性感知的计算路由机制，FreeOcc在保持连续时间预测能力和物理合理性的同时，实现了轻量、高效、鲁棒的4D占用世界建模，具有实际部署价值。

title: Describe Your Facial Expressions by Linking Image Encoders and Large Language Models
summary: This paper presents a novel task of describing human facial expressions of a facial image in natural language, which captures the nuances of facial actions and emotional states beyond traditional emotion categories or facial action units (AUs). To achieve the facial expression captioning model, we propose a three-stage training framework that trains a vision-to-language model using synthesized image-text pairs and the BLIP-2 pre-training techniques. To overcome the challenge of missing training image-text pairs for facial expression captioning, we propose a strategy that involves synthesizing and combining captions using GPT-3.5 and existing annotations on either emotion categories or AUs. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in generating captions that describe details of facial actions and emotions, as well as the inferential relationship between them, even when those emotions are not present in the training data. It is also demonstrated that the vision-to-language task enhances the performance of the intermediate visual features on both AU detection and emotion classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面部表情描述的新任务，并采用视觉-语言模型与多阶段训练框架实现自然语言生成。
AI.motivation: 传统表情分类或AU标注难以捕捉细微的面部动作、情绪状态及二者间的推理关系。
AI.method: 使用GPT-3.5合成/整合基于情绪类别或AU的文本标注，构建图像-文本对；基于BLIP-2预训练技术，以三阶段框架训练视觉转语言模型。
AI.result: 该方法能生成包含面部动作、情绪及二者关系的高质量描述，且对未见情绪具泛化性；同时提升视觉中间特征在AU检测和情绪分类上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 面部表情描述任务可行，合成训练数据与视觉-语言预训练有助于模型细粒度表达和下游表情理解。

title: MCUFlowNet: Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search for Optical Flow on Microcontrollers
summary: Dense optical flow allows small drones to avoid obstacles. However, few dense optical flow networks are designed for microcontrollers (MCUs) with neural accelerators, whose on-chip SRAM limits the input resolution. We present PACE-NAS, a macro-to-micro neural architecture search framework that decouples memory from latency: a macro design fixes the backbone and its peak SRAM, and a micro design searches operators and depths to trade accuracy against compiler-estimated latency. We apply it to EdgeFlowNet on a Grove Vision AI V2 board (Ethos-U55), where profiling locates the peak SRAM at the full-resolution output head. Replacing transposed convolutions with bilinear upsampling and convolutions lowers the peak SRAM by 18%, and two lightweight context modules lower the endpoint error (EPE) without raising the peak. All searched subnets share this peak, so the search needs no memory constraint. We name the Pareto-optimal models MCUFlowNet; the fastest variant, MCUFlowNet-S, runs 1.76x faster than a retrained EdgeFlowNet at a 1.6% higher EPE and, in simulated forest flights at 2 m/s, reaches the goal without collision in 51.5% of trials, against 41.8%. PACE-NAS also applies to semantic segmentation, where a searched PIDNet-S variant runs 1.17x faster at similar accuracy. Code is available at this https URL.
comment: Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027 (under review). 5 pages

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PACE-NAS，一种面向带神经加速器的微控制器的“宏观到微观”神经架构搜索框架，用于高效部署稠密光流网络；通过解耦内存与延迟，在 Grove Vision AI V2 / Ethos-U55 上优化 EdgeFlowNet，得到在延迟和精度间具有帕累托优势的 MCUFlowNet，并在仿真避障和语义分割任务中展现出通用性。
AI.motivation: 稠密光流可帮助小型无人机避障，但面向微控制器及其神经加速器的稠密光流网络较少。MCU 片上 SRAM 有限，尤其输入分辨率和输出头会显著增加峰值内存；同时不同操作符、网络深度又会影响编译后的推理延迟。因此需要一种能在严格内存限制下搜索并优化延迟与精度权衡的架构搜索方法。
AI.method: 作者提出 PACE-NAS，将架构搜索分解为宏观设计和微观设计两个层面：宏观设计固定骨干网络并确定其峰值 SRAM 使用；微观设计在此基础上搜索操作符和层深度，以在准确率与编译器估计的延迟之间进行权衡。以 EdgeFlowNet 为对象，在 Grove Vision AI V2 开发板（Ethos-U55 NPU）上进行剖析，发现峰值 SRAM 主要来自全分辨率输出头。进一步将转置卷积替换为双线性上采样加卷积以降低峰值内存，并加入两个轻量级上下文模块，在不增加峰值内存的情况下降低端点误差（EPE）。由于搜索得到的子网络共享同一峰值内存，因此搜索过程无需额外的内存约束。最终将帕累托最优模型命名为 MCUFlowNet，并将该方法扩展到语义分割任务，用于优化 PIDNet-S 变体。
AI.result: 实验表明，优化后的方案可使峰值 SRAM 降低约 18%，同时上下文模块降低了端点误差而不增加峰值内存。搜索得到的最快变体 MCUFlowNet-S 相比重新训练的 EdgeFlowNet 快 1.76 倍，但 EPE 增加 1.6%。在 2 m/s 的模拟森林飞行避障任务中，MCUFlowNet-S 的无碰撞到达目标成功率为 51.5%，高于对比方法的 41.8%。在语义分割上，PACE-NAS 搜索得到的 PIDNet-S 变体在精度相近的情况下运行速度提升 1.17 倍。
AI.conclusion: PACE-NAS 通过宏观固定内存上限、微观搜索延迟与精度权衡的策略，有效解决了 MCU 上稠密光流网络的部署瓶颈。该方法既能降低峰值 SRAM，又能在可接受的精度损失下显著提升推理速度，并改善无人机避障成功率，同时可推广到语义分割等其他视觉任务，适合资源受限的边缘神经加速器平台。

title: Improving Context-Shift Robustness of Convolutional Networks via Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy
summary: Image classification models often encounter objects in diverse and unpredictable contexts at test time, which may differ substantially from those seen during training. This phenomenon, termed context shift, exposes a key fragility in neural networks: when models rely on non-causal contextual cues for prediction, shifts in context can lead to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose a novel training framework to improve the robustness of convolutional neural networks under context shift. Our approach leverages spatial feature attribution to guide models toward making predictions that rely less on contextual regions and more on object-relevant features. As a first step, recognizing a theoretical limitation of existing feature attribution methods we introduce a new variant, ContrastiveCAMs, which produces more faithful attribution maps of model predictions. Building on ContrastiveCAMs, we further propose Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy (CR-CE), a modification of the standard cross-entropy loss that regularizes the model's attention by suppressing the influence of contextual regions, thereby improving robustness to context shift. We evaluate the effectiveness of our approach on several medium-to-large scale datasets (Waterbirds, Spawrious, ImageNet/ImageNet-BG, Hard-ImageNet), and report consistent improvements in context-shift robustness.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向上下文偏移的卷积神经网络鲁棒性训练框架，通过改进空间特征归因方法并构造上下文正则化交叉熵损失，降低模型对非因果上下文区域的依赖、增强对目标相关特征的依赖。
AI.motivation: 图像分类模型在测试时经常遇到与训练分布显著不同的上下文场景，即上下文偏移。如果模型依赖非因果的上下文线索进行分类，一旦上下文发生变化，性能会明显下降。因此，需要一种机制使模型减少依赖背景或上下文区域，而更多依赖真正与目标相关的特征，从而提高鲁棒性和可信度。
AI.method: 论文首先指出现有特征归因方法存在理论局限，提出新的变体 ContrastiveCAMs，以生成更忠实于模型预测的空间归因图。随后基于 ContrastiveCAMs 提出 Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy，即 CR-CE，该损失在标准交叉熵基础上引入上下文正则化，抑制模型对上下文区域的关注，同时引导模型学习更依赖目标相关特征的预测表征。
AI.result: 在多个中等规模到大规模数据集上，包括 Waterbirds、Spawrious、ImageNet/ImageNet-BG 和 Hard-ImageNet，论文评估了所提出方法。结果显示，该方法在上下文偏移场景下能够持续提升模型的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该论文表明，通过更忠实的空间特征归因和上下文敏感的训练目标，可以有效缓解卷积神经网络对非因果上下文线索的依赖，从而提升模型在分布外上下文变化下的分类鲁棒性与预测可信度。

title: ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLMs
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with impressive perception and understanding capabilities will enable a range of downstream applications. However, their substantial computational and memory requirements hinder the real-world implementation, particularly for resource-constrained edge devices. Quantization has emerged as an effective solution for deploying large models. While post-training quantization (PTQ) successfully retains the performance at moderate bit-width (e.g., W8A8), it suffers from severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization (e.g., W4A8), especially for small-scale models that are more suitable for edge deployment. In this paper, we propose ProQuant, a novel weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit MLLMs. First, to align the limited finetuning dataset distribution with the pretrained dataset distribution, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme to resample the responses of the open-source multimodal dataset. Second, we are the first to take a decoupled view of multi-modal (MM) understanding and language modeling abilities. We propose a progressive block activation (PBA) mechanism to prioritize the MM understanding recovery. We also introduce a vision-sensitive factor $\vec{\tau}$ that effectively identifies the MM-critical layers. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, covering models with 2B-8B parameters, show that ProQuant significantly outperforms existing methods. For example, our W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct improves average accuracy by impressively 6.6% and achieves performance comparable to full precision counterparts with only approximately 1% performance drop. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProQuant，一种面向低比特多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的权重量化与激活量化感知训练（QAT）框架，通过数据重标注、分阶段恢复多模态理解能力和识别视觉关键层，在W4A8等低比特场景下显著提升小参数MLLM的量化性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽具有强大的感知与理解能力，但计算和显存开销大，难以在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。训练后量化（PTQ）在中等比特宽度下表现较好，但在低比特量化时性能严重下降，尤其对适合边缘部署的小规模模型更加明显，因此需要专门针对低比特MLLM的量化方案。
AI.method: 提出ProQuant这一权重量化与激活量化联合的量化感知训练框架。首先，采用自重标注（self-relabeling, SRL）机制重新采样开源多模态数据集中的回答，以缓解微调数据分布与预训练数据分布不一致的问题。其次，首次将多模态（MM）理解能力与语言建模能力解耦，并提出渐进式块激活（progressive block activation, PBA）机制，优先恢复多模态理解能力。最后，引入视觉敏感因子τ，用于识别对多模态任务更为关键的视觉相关层。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试和2B至8B参数规模的模型上，ProQuant显著优于现有方法。例如，在W4A8量化设置下，Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct的平均准确率提升约6.6%，与全精度模型相比仅下降约1%，接近全精度性能。
AI.conclusion: ProQuant通过数据分布对齐、能力解耦建模、渐进式激活和视觉关键层识别，有效缓解了低比特MLLM量化中的性能退化问题，为资源受限边缘设备上的多模态大模型部署提供了可行的量化训练方案。

title: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
summary: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything with Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm), which canonicalizes a robust scene-level statistic of Gaussian spacing to provide a more consistent spatial reference for Gaussian prediction. To rigorously assess our method, we further establish a systematic benchmark spanning diverse datasets, input sparsity levels, and challenging extrapolated viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SplatAnything achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly strong gains under substantial variations in scene scale and viewpoint.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SplatAnything与GSNorm，通过规范化的场景级高斯间距统计改进前馈3D Gaussian Splatting预测，并建立覆盖多数据集、稀疏输入和外推视角的系统基准，取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法常在径向距离归一化空间中预测高斯属性，但该归一化主要处理全局径向统计，仍无法稳定消除场景尺度和相机配置带来的高斯中心间距变化，导致高斯尺度目标产生系统性偏移，监督信号变得模糊。
AI.method: 提出Gaussian Spacing Normalization，即GSNorm，使用更鲁棒的场景级高斯间距统计进行规范化，为高斯中心间距和尺度等属性预测提供一致的空间参考；同时构建涵盖多种数据集、不同输入稀疏程度和困难外推视角的系统化评测基准。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和设置下，SplatAnything达到当前最优性能，尤其在场景尺度变化和相机外推视角变化较大的条件下表现出明显增益。
AI.conclusion: 高斯间距规范化能缓解前馈3DGS中因场景尺度与视角配置变化导致的目标属性不一致问题，提升跨场景、稀疏输入和外推视角下的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title: DART: Domain-Agnostic Residual Transfer for Generalist Anomaly Detection
summary: Generalist Anomaly Detection (GAD) aims to detect anomalies in unseen domains using only a few reference samples. Recent normal-abnormal guided methods improve this setting by exploiting abnormal references, but their residuals often mix transferable anomaly cues with domain-specific appearance factors such as texture, geometry, and acquisition conditions. This residual domain entanglement limits cross-domain transfer and may produce spurious activations on novel domains. We propose DART, a plug-in framework for normal-abnormal guided GAD that learns to separate residuals into anomaly-relevant and domain-specific components. DART combines a Residual Disentanglement Module, which preserves anomaly-discriminative information while suppressing domain information, with Cross-Domain Meta-Training, which forms episodes across source domains to make the separation effective. The method is architecture-agnostic and can be inserted between residual computation and the detection head of existing GAD pipelines. Experiments on MVTec AD, VisA, and BraTS show consistent improvements over multiple base methods, with the largest gains under stronger domain shifts. this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出DART，一种即插即用的通用异常检测框架，用于将正常-异常引导方法中的残差解耦为异常相关成分和域相关成分，从而提升跨域异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有正常-异常引导的通用异常检测方法虽然利用异常参考样本进行残差建模，但残差中往往混合了可迁移的异常线索与纹理、几何、采集条件等域相关外观因素。这种残差域纠缠会削弱跨域迁移能力，并在新域上产生错误激活。
AI.method: DART通过两个核心模块解决该问题：一是残差解耦模块，在保留异常判别信息的同时抑制域相关信息；二是跨域元训练策略，通过在多个源域上构造episode来增强解耦效果。该框架与具体架构无关，可插入现有通用异常检测流程中残差计算与检测头之间。
AI.result: 在MVTec AD、VisA和BraTS数据集上的实验表明，DART能够一致提升多种基线方法的异常检测性能，并且在更强的域偏移条件下带来最明显的增益。

title: Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
summary: Visual interaction models that support users during ongoing physical tasks require evaluation in closed loop, where assistant responses can change subsequent user behavior and task outcomes. Existing benchmarks largely rely on offline replay and therefore cannot capture these effects. We introduce Interactive Visual Gym, a framework for closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models through joint simulation of executable task environments and human users. We contribute three simulators that recreate everyday tasks and human-aligned action spaces across cooking, household manipulation, and mobile-interface domains, together with a persona-conditioned user simulation harness that collaborates with the assistant while incorporating controlled execution errors and other out-of-plan behaviors. We instantiate the framework as IVG-Bench, a benchmark with 315 interaction scenarios. Evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs as visual interaction models reveals substantial limitations: the best-performing model, Gemini 4 Argon, completes only 53.4% of tasks within the time limit, exhibits significant weaknesses in factual grounding and actionable guidance, and is often too slow to prevent errors when response latency is considered. We verify our evaluation protocol with a human study which finds 78.5% agreement between our interaction-quality metric and participant preferences. We further show that the environments provide useful learning signals: in a proof-of-concept GRPO experiment, closed-loop training improves both task success and interaction quality for Qwen3.5-4B model in our cooking environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Interactive Visual Gym（IVG）框架及 IVG-Bench 基准，用于对支持真实物理/移动任务的视觉交互模型进行闭环评估与训练，并发现现有 VLM 在事实基础、可操作指导和响应时延方面仍显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉交互基准多依赖离线回放，无法刻画助手回答如何改变用户后续行为与任务结果；对于需要持续指导物理操作的模型，必须闭环评估交互质量与任务完成效果。
AI.method: 作者构建三个面向烹饪、家务操作和移动界面任务的执行式环境仿真器，并加入基于人设的用户仿真模块，模拟人类对齐动作空间、受控执行误差和计划外行为；形成 315 个交互场景的 IVG-Bench，并用人类研究验证评估协议，同时通过 GRPO 实验验证闭环训练信号。
AI.result: 在 SOTA VLM 评估中，最佳模型 Gemini 4 Argon 在时限内仅完成 53.4% 任务，并在事实 grounding、可操作建议以及低延迟防错方面存在明显弱点；人类研究显示交互质量指标与参与者偏好一致率为 78.5%；GRPO 证明闭环训练能提升 Qwen3.5-4B 在烹饪环境中的任务成功率和交互质量。
AI.conclusion: IVG 提供了可闭环评测与训练视觉交互模型的新基础设施，表明当前 VLM 作为实时任务助手仍不成熟，需重点改进事实性、可执行指导、延迟响应和动态交互能力。

title: Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting for Online Reconstruction
summary: Online 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs a scene during capture: each keyframe spawns primitives once and refines them for only a few dozen iterations, leaving little chance to fix poor initialization or missing detail. Gaussians are also inherently soft, needing many overlaps for solid surfaces. We present Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting (HIBS), which brings beta kernels to incremental reconstruction. Their shape parameter interpolates between a soft, Gaussian-like profile and a flat-topped, near-opaque surfel, acting as a confidence dial for geometry. Our confidence-aware spawning uses geometric observability and multi-view depth agreement to initialize both opacity and shape, producing solid primitives where geometry is verifiable and soft, correctable primitives where it is not. As online densification, error-driven relocation recycles stale primitives into photometric-error hotspots. Bounded beta kernel support enables exact tile culling and faster rasterization, and a closed-form, shape-preserving merging formulation provides a level-of-detail (LOD) hierarchy for fast optimization and real-time rendering. On Mip-NeRF 360 in the on-the-fly protocol, HIBS improves PSNR by up to 0.8 dB while reducing optimization time by up to 40%. Project page: this https URL

title: ManimCode: Learning Visual Self-Correction for Educational Animation
summary: Manim supports precise, programmatic video generation, but a successfully rendered educational animation can still have visual defects, missing explanations, or incorrect content. Rendering does not directly identify the code changes needed to correct these visual failures, so feedback-driven revision is needed. Existing agentic frameworks use iterative rendering and revision but typically rely on large models, often proprietary. Existing Manim datasets primarily contain final programs and often lack quality verification and the trajectories of feedback and revisions needed to learn this refinement process. We introduce ManimData and ManimCode, a data and training framework for feedback-driven educational animation generation. We construct ManimData through a render-guided pipeline that iteratively generates, executes, reviews, and revises Manim programs with retrieved API documentation. Its 24,034 render-verified, quality-filtered records preserve intermediate programs, execution errors, visual critiques, and corrective revisions. We use role-conditioned supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories to train ManimCode, a single 4B model, to write, review, and revise animation programs. To improve correction of errors that differ from those in the collected trajectories, we then train the Reviser with reinforcement learning on self-generated states, using rendering outcomes and reference-free quality feedback. ManimCode achieves 96.6% and 97.0% render success on ManimData-test and ManimBench, compared with 52.6% and 82.0% for the untrained 4B model under the same inference setup, while also improving video quality scores from 2.48 to 2.94 and from 3.00 to 3.44. Integrating ManimCode into two long-form educational video generation systems increases completed videos from 19/117 to 107/117 and from 53/239 to 239/239, alongside improvements in educational effectiveness and visual quality.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出 ManimData 数据集与 ManimCode 训练框架，通过“渲染—检查—修正”轨迹训练一个 4B 小模型，以提升 Manim 教育动画程序的自动撰写、审查与纠错能力。
AI.motivation: Manim 能程序化生成高质量教学动画，但代码渲染成功并不等于视频内容正确；常见缺陷包括视觉布局问题、解释缺失、步骤错误或教学表达不佳。仅依赖最终代码数据集无法学习从渲染错误和视觉问题反馈中定位并修正代码的过程。
AI.method: 作者构建 render-guided 数据流水线：检索 API 文档，迭代生成、执行、评审和修订 Manim 代码，形成 ManimData。数据集包含 24,034 条渲染验证、质量过滤样本，保留中间程序、执行错误、视觉批评和修正版本。随后用 role-conditioned supervised fine-tuning 训练单一 4B 模型 ManimCode，使其分别承担写代码、审代码和改代码的角色；并进一步用强化训练优化 Reviser，基于自生成状态、渲染结果和无需参考视频的质量反馈来提升对未见错误的修正能力。
AI.result: ManimCode 在 ManimData-test 和 ManimBench 上分别达到 96.6% 和 97.0% 的渲染成功率，显著高于同一推理设置下未训练 4B 模型的 52.6% 和 82.0%。视频质量评分也从 2.48 提升到 2.94、从 3.00 提升到 3.44。在两个长视频教育动画生成系统中接入后，完成视频数分别从 19/117 提升到 107/117、从 53/239 提升到 239/239，同时改善教学效果和视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将渲染执行、视觉批评和代码修订轨迹作为训练数据，并结合角色化监督微调与强化修正，可以让小模型胜任教育动画代码的生成与迭代纠错，从而显著提升长视频自动生成的可用性和质量。

title: InstantHand: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Animatable Hand Avatar Reconstruction from a Single Image
summary: Hand avatar reconstruction typically relies on multi-view capture or per-subject optimization, limiting its scalability. We introduce InstantHand, a feed-forward framework that constructs an animatable 3D Gaussian hand avatar from a single image using off-the-shelf MANO, camera, and mask estimates, without test-time optimization. Image-averaged losses provide insufficient supervision for alpha leakage, which thickens thin finger contours. To address this issue, we propose a Soft Alpha Band regularizer that concentrates supervision on silhouette boundaries. Furthermore, colors regressed from image features can drift toward a learned prior even in observed regions. Our Reliability-gated Appearance Transfer preserves observed appearance by transferring source colors according to each Gaussian's rendering contribution, while completing unobserved regions using the learned prior conditioned on global source identity. InstantHand constructs an avatar in 2.84 seconds and renders at 161 FPS, matching per-subject-optimized baselines on InterHand2.6M and remaining competitive in zero-shot evaluation on HanCo.

AI.method: InstantHand 采用前馈框架，从单张图像出发，结合现成的 MANO 参数、相机估计和掩码估计，直接生成可驱动的 3D 高斯手部表示，不进行测试时优化。针对 alpha 泄漏，提出 Soft Alpha Band 正则器，将监督集中在轮廓边界带以提升薄边缘的重建质量。针对颜色漂移，提出 Reliability-gated Appearance Transfer，根据每个高斯的渲染贡献度进行可靠性门控：在观测区域保留并迁移源图像颜色，在未观测区域使用以全局源身份为条件的学习先验完成外观生成。

title: 4D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Micro-Doppler Differentiable Rendering
summary: Millimeter-wave radar resolves the micrometer displacements of a moving body as micro-Doppler, enabling gait, gesture, activity, pose and vital-sign sensing. Each task relies on a downstream model trained on real data, yet radar datasets lag orders of magnitude behind vision and language. Brute-force collection will not close that gap, and existing synthesis methods (forward-only simulators, learned generators and static-scene inverse renderers) cannot fit a real capture of a moving body, leaving a sim2real gap. We present 4D Point Splatting (4DPS), a physics-based differentiable renderer that fits an explicit moving scene to a real capture. Using the synchronized camera to initialize the room and body, we represent the scene as oriented points carrying material, normal and velocity, and splat each point into range and Doppler bins. Our output is the raw complex return a real radar records, so we apply the same signal processing on the rendered data to obtain any representation for training any SOTA downstream model. We fit 235 sequences on HuPR and 100 on RT-Pose, two datasets with different radars. Our reconstructions set the state of the art, with median correlations of 0.940 and 0.830 on range-azimuth, 0.829 and 0.695 on range-Doppler, and 0.988 and 0.966 on micro-Doppler. Our renders also set the state of the art in downstream sim2real gap. On RT-Pose, a pose model trained on them reaches 21.9 cm MPJPE on real data, against 16.7 cm for real training and 127.6 cm for the RF-Genesis baseline, where both the rendered- and real-trained models learn nearly the same features. Our custom CUDA kernels fit a sequence in 5.7 minutes on HuPR and 12.9 on RT-Pose on one H100, making dataset-scale inverse rendering of mmWave radar possible for the first time. This work can enable synthetic data generation for any human-centered downstream task and model, and scene editing for data augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 4D Point Splatting（4DPS），一种物理一致、可微分的毫米波雷达逆渲染方法，通过显式建模动态人体与场景来拟合真实雷达回波，缩小雷达合成数据与真实采集之间的 sim2real 差距。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达可借助微多普勒感知步态、手势、动作、姿态和生命体征等人体信息，但相关模型高度依赖真实采集的雷达数据。现有雷达数据集远少于视觉和语言数据，单纯扩大采集成本高昂；而已有前向仿真、生成模型或静态逆渲染方法难以拟合真实动态人体回波，导致合成数据难以替代真实数据。
AI.method: 作者提出 4DPS：先利用同步相机初始化房间和人体；将场景表示为带有材质、法向和速度的定向点；将这些点 splat 到距离维和多普勒维中；直接渲染出真实雷达记录的原始复数回波，并使用与真实数据相同的信号处理流程生成下游模型所需输入。该方法为可微逆渲染器，可通过拟合真实雷达捕捉来优化动态场景模型，并以自定义 CUDA kernel 加速。

AI.conclusion: 4DPS 通过显式、物理可微分的动态场景表示，直接拟合真实毫米波雷达原始回波，为人体感知任务提供了高质量的合成雷达数据生成与场景编辑能力，显著缩小 sim2real 差距，并有望成为雷达数据集扩展和下游模型训练的通用基础设施。

title: USB Gym: A Gymnasium Testbed for Closed-Loop Ultrasound View Matching
summary: Background and Objective: Our main goal is ultrasound guidance: moving a probe until its image matches a target view. Published methods for each part of a guide are evaluated in separate simulators. We asked whether these methods, combined into one guide, are good enough. Methods: We built USB Gym, a testbed whose standard engine simulates ultrasound from public patient CT, with a network drawing organ textures from CT labels. Its guide has three replaceable parts (slots), an organ segmenter, a controller and a reward, which received 20 published methods, each run on the same 60 episodes of six held-out patients. In each slot, a published method replaced ours only if detectably better on these patients. The better of this combination and our original guide on 20 new CTs is the benchmark baseline. A pose oracle, reading the exact probe pose available only in simulation, set the reference. The results below are exploratory. Results: On these CTs, the probe started on average 16.0 mm from the target view; the pose oracle brought it to 1.5 mm. Of the results known when the combination was fixed, only an image-similarity reward (SSIM) was slightly but detectably better, so the combination was our guide with that reward. This combination was the benchmark baseline, ending at 13.7 mm (16% of the oracle's progress). Conclusions: Combining untuned published methods with ours did not guide the probe near the target view; the task remains under-explored. The testbed accepts new methods; no guide was tested on hardware.

AI.motivation: 超声引导任务要求移动超声探头，使其成像视图逐渐匹配目标视图。现有方法通常分别评估超声图像中的器官分割、控制策略和奖励设计，并在不同模拟环境中测试，导致难以判断这些模块组合成一个完整引导系统时是否真正有效。因此，本研究旨在构建统一测试床，系统检验已发表方法组合后的端到端引导能力。

title: Adaptive Low-Light Enhancement for Road Anomaly Detection: A Multi-Architecture Benchmark and Edge Deployment Study
summary: Road anomaly detection systems on autonomous vehicles must function reliably under degraded visual conditions including darkness, rain, and Harmattan dust haze. This paper benchmarks four object detection architectures, YOLOv8n, YOLOv12n, RT-DETR, and Faster R-CNN, under physically grounded lighting and weather degradation, and shows that uniform application of the SCI low-light enhancement network is actively harmful at dusk-level lighting (-16.1% to -30.7% mAP@50). We propose a lightweight, training-free luminance-adaptive router that selects between no enhancement, moderate SCI, and denoising plus strong SCI based on per-frame Rec. 601 luminance, recovering most of the dusk penalty while preserving low-light gains, and we validate the full pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson Nano edge hardware.

AI.tldr: 论文针对自动驾驶道路异常检测在低光照、雨雾和Harmattan尘霾等退化视觉条件下的可靠性问题，评测了多种检测器，并发现盲目使用SCI低光增强会在黄昏光照下显著降低精度；进而提出基于逐帧Rec. 601亮度的免训练自适应增强路由策略，在边缘设备上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶异常检测系统需要在真实恶劣视觉条件下稳定运行，但已有低光增强方法通常假设越亮越好，未考虑不同光照区间对检测器的差异化影响，尤其黄昏等中等暗光条件下增强可能引入过曝、伪影或对比度失真，损害下游检测。
AI.method: 作者以物理化光照和天气退化为基准，对YOLOv8n、YOLOv12n、RT-DETR和Faster R-CNN进行评测；进一步提出轻量免训练的亮度自适应路由器，根据逐帧Rec. 601亮度在“不增强”“中等SCI增强”“去噪加强SCI增强”之间切换，并在NVIDIA Jetson Nano边缘硬件上验证完整流水线。
AI.result: 结果表明，统一应用SCI低光增强在黄昏级光照下会导致mAP@50下降16.1%至30.7%；提出的自适应路由策略能恢复大部分黄昏场景性能损失，同时保留低光增强收益，并且适配边缘部署约束。
AI.conclusion: 该工作强调退化图像增强不应作为固定预处理，而应依据实时场景亮度进行自适应控制；对于自动驾驶边缘检测系统，训练无关、低延迟的亮度路由机制能提升不同光照与天气条件下的鲁棒性和可用性。

title: SM4RT: Cascaded Feed-forward Model for 4D Reconstruction
summary: We introduce SM4RT, a multi-task cascade feed-forward model for dynamic scene reconstruction from RGB videos. While existing feed-forward approaches typically address geometry reconstruction and motion estimation separately--and often predict motions in a single coordinate frame that must account for camera movement--SM4RT solves these tasks sequentially by first reconstructing 3D geometry and then bootstrapping motion estimation from the predicted structure. By expressing each pixel's 3D motion in its corresponding camera frame, SM4RT reduces ambiguity arising from camera motion. To address the sparsity of real-world motion labels, SM4RT further incorporates a weakly supervised loss that regularizes unlabeled point motions using labeled point positions at the other time step. We evaluate motion estimation on three dynamic-scene datasets--Kubric, Waymo, and Point Odyssey--and SM4RT achieves the best performance on most metrics compared with prior baselines. We additionally benchmark geometry reconstruction on five dynamic scene datasets and show that SM4RT achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods. Overall, our unified framework demonstrates that combining geometry reconstruction and motion estimation in a cascade not only avoids performance trade-offs but also enhances motion estimation through improved geometric reasoning.

AI.tldr: SM4RT 是一种面向动态场景重建的多任务级联前馈模型，先从 RGB 视频预测三维几何，再基于几何预测相机坐标系下的逐像素三维运动；通过弱监督损失缓解运动标签稀疏问题，并在多个数据集上取得领先或具有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈动态场景重建方法通常分别处理几何重建和运动估计，且运动预测多位于单一坐标系中，需要额外补偿相机自身运动，导致歧义较大。此外，真实场景中的像素级运动标注稀疏，限制了运动估计模型的学习与泛化。因此，需要一个统一框架同时利用几何信息改进运动估计，并在有限监督下稳定优化。
AI.method: 提出 SM4RT，一个多任务级联前馈网络，对 RGB 视频按顺序完成动态场景重建：第一步预测三维几何结构，第二步以预测结构为引导估计逐像素三维运动。模型将每个像素的运动表示在其对应相机坐标系中，以降低相机运动带来的歧义。针对真实运动标签稀疏，引入弱监督损失，利用另一时刻已标注点的位置对未标注点运动进行正则化。
AI.result: 在 Kubric、Waymo 和 Point Odyssey 三个动态场景数据集上进行运动估计实验，SM4RT 在多数指标上优于先前基线方法。进一步在五个动态场景数据集上评估几何重建，SM4RT 取得与最先进方法相当的性能。整体结果表明，几何重建与运动估计的级联结合不仅没有造成性能权衡，还通过更强的几何推理提升了运动估计效果。
AI.conclusion: SM4RT 证明了将几何重建作为运动估计的辅助先验、并在相机坐标系中建模像素级三维运动，是动态场景视频重建的有效范式。该框架能够缓解相机运动歧义和运动监督稀疏问题，实现几何与运动任务的统一建模与相互增益。

title: Edge-Assisted Crowdsensing for Explainable Cyclist Safety Perception
summary: Cyclist fatality rates remain high despite policy support for active travel, and autonomous vehicles add complexity to mixed traffic. Neither crash statistics nor multi-model detection pipelines scale to continuous monitoring of perceived safety along a route. We present an edge-assisted crowdsensing system: handlebar cameras supply street-level frames, a vision-language model (VLM) turns each frame into structured traffic attributes through a single prompt, and an explainable boosting machine (EBM) combines them with OpenStreetMap road infrastructure and on-bike kinematics to predict a crowdsourced 1-9 safety score. Extraction belongs at the network edge: the fastest self-hosted model needs 2.49 s per frame and scoring takes 0.4 ms on a CPU. On 1,362 annotated frames from two London routes, the EBM regressor reaches 72.2 percent binary accuracy and a mean absolute error of 1.011 under five-fold cross-validation. It is within one accuracy point of black-box ensembles. Its per-feature shape functions give exact attribution: physical lane separation is worth +0.97 rating points, a painted lane +0.70 and a construction site -0.65. Planners can therefore price an infrastructure change in rating points, and the results enter cost-benefit analysis directly. We also report inter-annotator agreement (alpha = 0.4695), an attribute audit, and a sensitivity analysis linking attribute error to accuracy. With re-encoding, a 20 s sampling interval serves 1,000 riders at 54 Mbit/s at a cost of 1.4 accuracy points, making continuous monitoring practical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种边缘辅助的骑行安全众感系统：通过车把摄像头采集街道视频帧，使用视觉语言模型提取交通场景属性，并结合OpenStreetMap道路基础设施与骑行运动学特征，利用可解释梯度提升机预测骑行者主观安全评分，以支持连续、可解释、可扩展的主动出行安全评估与道路规划。
AI.motivation: 尽管政策支持主动出行，自行车事故死亡率仍然较高；自动驾驶车辆加入后，混合交通环境更加复杂。传统事故统计和多模型检测流水线难以支撑对路线沿线连续、可解释的主观骑行安全监测。
AI.method: 系统由骑行者车把摄像头提供街道级视频帧；一个视觉语言模型通过单次提示将每帧转换为结构化交通属性；可解释梯度提升机将这些属性与OpenStreetMap道路基础设施特征和骑行运动学特征融合，预测1-9分的众包安全评分。模型部署在网络边缘以处理帧级视觉抽取，并进一步评估采样间隔、编码方式、通信带宽、标注者一致性、属性审计及属性误差对精度的敏感性。
AI.result: 在伦敦两条路线的1,362个标注帧上，五折交叉验证显示EBM回归器达到72.2%的二分类准确率和1.011的平均绝对误差，与黑盒集成模型相比差距在1个百分点以内。最快的自托管视觉语言模型抽取需要2.49秒/帧，评分仅需CPU上0.4毫秒。特征形状函数给出明确归因：物理车道分隔带来+0.97分，划线车道带来+0.70分，施工路段造成-0.65分。标注者一致性为alpha=0.4695。通过重编码，20秒采样间隔可在54 Mbit/s带宽下服务1,000名骑行者，仅损失1.4个百分点准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该边缘辅助VLM-EBM系统能够在有限算力和带宽条件下实现骑行主观安全感的连续、可扩展监测，并通过可解释特征归因帮助规划者量化道路基础设施改造的安全收益，但标注一致性和属性抽取误差仍是实际应用中的关键约束。

title: EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
summary: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. We present EgoGeneralist, which adapts pretrained video generators to unify action-conditioned egocentric video generation, pose estimation, and joint action-video generation. Our role-adaptive action renderer provides video-native representations for multidirectional action-video learning, making metric motion usable as both a spatial control signal and a recoverable generation target. Cross-stream action-video coupling establishes close correspondence between metric motion and visual dynamics through lightweight adaptation while preserving the pretrained visual prior. Together, these designs establish a generalist framework spanning five action-video tasks. Despite adaptation only on controlled laboratory recordings, EgoGeneralist generalizes to diverse unseen scenes and interactions with effective action control and visual quality, bridging pretrained visual knowledge and metric 3D human motion.

AI.tldr: EgoGeneralist 将预训练视频生成模型适配到第一人称动作相关任务，统一动作条件视频生成、姿态估计与动作-视频联合生成，实现度量三维人体动作与视频视觉动态之间的桥接。
AI.motivation: 现代视频模型具有强视觉先验，但不天然表示度量三维空间中的人体动作。作者希望让预训练视频生成器既能利用其视觉生成能力，又能理解和控制真实空间尺度下的人体运动，从而在一个通用框架中支持多种动作-视频任务。
AI.method: 提出 EgoGeneralist，通过轻量级适配预训练视频生成器，引入角色自适应的动作渲染器，将度量动作表示为视频原生表征，使其既能作为空间控制信号，也能作为可恢复的生成目标；同时设计跨流动作-视频耦合机制，在保持预训练视觉先验的前提下建立度量运动与视觉动态之间的紧密对应。该框架覆盖五种动作-视频任务。
AI.result: 尽管仅在受控实验室记录上进行适配训练，EgoGeneralist 能够泛化到多种未见场景和交互任务，并保持有效的动作控制与较高视觉质量，体现了桥接预训练视觉知识与三维人体动作的能力。
AI.conclusion: EgoGeneralist 表明，通过视频原生动作表示与跨流动作-视频耦合，预训练视频模型可以被有效扩展为动作理解、动作控制和动作-视频联合生成的通用框架，为连接视觉生成先验与度量空间人体动作提供了可行路径。

title: Where and Why is Grounded Reasoning Useful?
summary: Grounded reasoning, where a model outputs text coordinates of relevant locations in chain-of-thought reasoning, is a common strategy for solving complex visual reasoning problems. However, the benefits and limitations of grounded reasoning are understudied. We study where and why grounded reasoning is most useful. To do so, we introduce a chain-of-thought analysis method to measure how much a model uses its outputted grounding in its thinking trace and perform a detailed ablation study of a grounded reasoning training recipe. We find that grounded reasoning improves counting but shows no significant gain over baselines without coordinate grounding across a wide range of spatial reasoning and perception benchmarks. Using several synthetic tasks, we show that grounded reasoning is most useful when a task requires undescribable references, which are visual concepts that are difficult to describe in language. However, we observe that many existing visual reasoning benchmarks are solvable with only describable text references. To close this gap, we introduce BrickVision, a new benchmark that requires undescribable visual references to solve.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统考察“接地推理”（grounded reasoning，即在思维链中输出目标位置的坐标文本）在视觉复杂推理中的作用与局限，发现其收益主要出现在难以用语言描述视觉参考的任务中，并据此提出新基准 BrickVision。
AI.motivation: 接地推理被广泛用于提升模型的视觉推理能力，但其实际收益、适用场景以及局限仍缺乏系统研究。作者希望回答：接地推理在哪些任务上最有用，以及为什么会带来增益或无明显增益。
AI.method: 作者提出一种思维链分析方法，用于衡量模型在推理轨迹中在多大程度上真正利用了其输出的坐标接地信息；同时对接地推理训练流程进行详细消融研究。此外，作者设计或利用若干合成任务，区分“可用语言描述”的视觉参考与“难以用语言描述”的视觉参考，以分析接地推理的有效边界。最后，为弥补现有基准不足，提出 BrickVision 基准，要求模型依赖难以文本描述的视觉参考进行推理。
AI.result: 实验发现，接地推理在计数任务上有明显提升，但在大量空间推理和感知基准上，相对于不使用坐标接地的基线并没有显著增益。作者进一步表明，接地推理最有用的情形是任务需要“不可描述引用”（undescribable references），即某些视觉概念很难仅用语言准确表达；而许多现有视觉推理基准实际上只依赖“可描述”的文本引用即可解决，因此难以体现接地推理的优势。
AI.conclusion: 接地推理并非普遍有效的增强手段，其价值取决于任务中是否存在语言难以充分表达的视觉指称对象。该工作揭示了现有基准对接地推理优势的低敏感性，并提出 BrickVision 以更公平、更直接地评估模型利用空间坐标和不可描述视觉引用进行推理的能力。

title: Do You Miss the Nights We Spent Crafting Figures? Rethinking Teaser and Framework Figures in the Age of Generative AI
summary: Scientific figures give research ideas a visual form through choices of abstraction, composition, and emphasis. Generative AI offers new ways to realize these choices, raising questions about explanatory clarity and purposeful visual expression. We examine these questions through a visual retrospective of 371 motivation and framework figures from 200 papers. The corpus comprises a quota-based main sample of 160 papers spanning four temporal periods and a separate purposive style-contrast sample of 40 papers. A single multimodal judge evaluates six dimensions of communication and design, with three repeated judgments per figure. We attempt source-constrained revisions of all 371 figures, of which 369 pass the recorded fidelity checks. Original-figure ratings show no uniform decline across periods. Revisions increase mean clarity ratings by 0.428 points and decrease aesthetic coherence ratings by 0.111 points on a five-point scale. Gains in the six-dimension average are larger for main-sample motivation figures than for frameworks. Case analyses show that added explanation can clarify comparisons while leaving typographic hierarchy and visual economy unresolved. These model-based findings support researcher-led design, with AI assisting exploration and authors retaining responsibility for explanatory purpose, composition, and scientific relationships. The accompanying atlas and evaluation records are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对200篇论文中的371张科研示意图进行多模态评审与“源约束修订”实验，发现AI式修订可提升图形的说明清晰度，但会削弱审美一致性，因而支持由研究者主导设计、AI辅助探索的科研配图路径。
AI.motivation: 科学示意图通过抽象、构图和强调来传达研究思想；生成式AI为这类视觉表达提供了新的实现方式，但也引发关于解释清晰度、设计质量以及科研图示中“说明性目的”是否仍由作者掌控的问题。
AI.method: 研究者构建了一个科研示意图视觉回顾样本：包含200篇论文中的371张动机图和框架图，其中按时间分层抽取160篇论文形成主要样本，另有40篇论文构成风格对比样本。对每张图从六个沟通与设计维度进行多模态自动评审，并对全部371张图尝试“保留源信息约束”的AI修订；其中369张通过保真性检查。原始图与修订图按评分比较，并辅以案例分析和重复评价记录。
AI.result: 原始图的评分并未随时间整体下降。相较原图，修订版在五分量表上的平均清晰度提高0.428分，但审美一致性下降0.111分；在主要样本中，动机图的六维平均分增益大于框架图。案例显示，AI增加解释性元素可改善比较表达，却难以同时解决排版层级和视觉简洁性问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持“以研究者为中心的科研图示设计”：AI可辅助生成、修订和探索表达方式，但作者仍应负责解释目的、构图逻辑和科学关系的表达，以避免过度自动化导致审美或视觉层级退化。

title: Kinematic Hypothesis Context: Embodiment-Conditioned Learned Video Coding for Bandwidth-Limited Robot Policy Uplinks
summary: Robots increasingly run large vision-language-action policies on remote servers, making the camera uplink the bottleneck. Existing video codecs spend bits on content the receiver could predict: the robot's own motion. We introduce the kinematic hypothesis context, a zero-rate conditioning signal that both ends build from joint states, the robot model and the camera calibration. Ego-motion homographies, per-link robot reprojections, an end-effector plane and a background memory warp the previous reconstruction into hypotheses that condition a learned video codec. We prove that history-only and global-pose conditioning with a limited receptive field cannot access this information under large motion, and that coding gains become task gains at the policy's success cliff. On LIBERO, the context saves 23.9% bit rate over a capacity-matched history-conditioned codec and 40-56% over x264, x265 and SVT-AV1, and needs 23.2% fewer bits than DCVC-RT at equal policy action deviation; trained to lower rates, it matches DCVC-RT in PSNR. In closed loop at equal rate, OpenVLA-OFT success nearly doubles from 22.8% to 43.1% at 6 kbps (72.6% with lower-rate training, 23.6 points above DCVC-RT), pi_0.5 success rises from 55.5% to 77.4%, and the gain grows under packet loss. The context transfers across three codec hosts and to real robot data.
comment: 15 pages, 12 figures. Preprint; supplementary material and code to be released upon formal publication

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向远程机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）控制的“运动学假设上下文”视频编码方法，利用机器人自身运动信息作为零额外码率的条件信号，使编解码器双方都能基于关节状态、机器人模型和相机标定生成预测内容，从而显著降低相机上行链路码率，并提升下游策略成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人常将大规模 VLA 策略部署在远程服务器上，相机视频上行成为带宽和延迟瓶颈。传统视频编码器会对可由机器人自身运动预测的内容分配比特，例如相机自运动、机械臂连杆移动和末端执行器区域，这些内容实际上可以被接收端利用运动学先验重建为“假设帧”。因此需要一种与机器人物理运动模型耦合、且不增加额外控制码率的上下文编码机制。
AI.method: 作者构建零码率的运动学假设上下文：编码端和解码端均利用关节状态、机器人模型和相机标定信息，将上一帧重建图像通过自运动单应变换、连杆重投影、末端执行器平面建模和背景记忆机制变换为当前帧的预测假设，再以此作为条件引导学习型视频编码器。论文还从理论上证明，在仅依赖历史帧和全局位姿、且感受野有限的编码条件下，大运动场景中无法充分访问此类运动学信息；同时论证视频编码层面的增益可在策略性能出现“成功率悬崖”时转化为任务性能增益。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上，该方法相比容量匹配的历史帧条件编码器节省 23.9% 码率，相比 x264、x265 和 SVT-AV1 节省 40–56% 码率。在相同策略动作偏差下，其所需码率比 DCVC-RT 少 23.2%；若训练至更低码率，PSNR 可与 DCVC-RT 匹配。闭环实验中，在相同码率下 OpenVLA-OFT 在 6 kbps 时成功率从 22.8% 提升到 43.1%，采用更低码率训练后达到 72.6%，较 DCVC-RT 高 23.6 个百分点；pi_0.5 成功率从 55.5% 提升到 77.4%，且增益在丢包条件下进一步扩大。该方法可迁移到不同视频编码器和真实机器人数据。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将机器人运动学先验作为共享零码率上下文，可以让视频编码与具身智能任务目标对齐，在极低上行带宽下显著改善 VLA 策略的闭环性能。其贡献不仅是高效视频压缩，更是面向机器人智能通信链路和下游任务性能提升的跨层编码范式。

title: MessyNav: Zero-Shot Navigation via Manipulation in Messy Environments
summary: Real-world environments are messy, with paths often blocked by everyday objects like chairs and toys, requiring robots to perform interactive navigation by manipulating obstacles to clear a path. Existing methods rely on extensive simulation-based learning or per-scene instructions specifying which objects to avoid or manipulate. They struggle to generalize across novel objects, diverse environments, and varied contexts such as a cart of fragile glassware that should be avoided while an empty one can be pushed. We formalize this problem as open-world interactive navigation and present MessyNav, a zero-shot framework based on vision-language models (VLMs). At its core, MessyNav performs explicit VLM-based affordance reasoning before task planning to decide whether to swipe, pick up, or avoid an object and produce a high-level plan. title: FREE-LIVO: Physically Decoupled Yet Tightly Coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry
summary: LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) integrates complementary LiDAR, camera, and IMU measurements to achieve robust state estimation. However, most existing methods assume a fixed relative pose and accurate time synchronization between sensors. Toward modular and heterogeneous robotic systems, this paper presents FREE-LIVO, a tightly coupled odometry method that requires neither a rigid LiDAR-camera rig nor LiDAR-camera time synchronization. The proposed method uses a pretrained image feature matcher to establish correspondences between a camera image and a dense LiDAR intensity image generated from a single LiDAR scan using a generative model. From the resulting 3D point-to-pixel correspondences, we construct reprojection factors that directly constrain LiDAR and camera poses at different acquisition times. These factors are jointly optimized in a single factor graph together with constraints from point cloud registration, visual feature tracking, and the IMU measurements associated with each sensor. On six sequences from the public M3DGR dataset, FREE-LIVO achieves an average absolute trajectory error (ATE) RMSE of 0.45 m without provided LiDAR-camera extrinsic parameters and exhibits minimal accuracy degradation under time synchronization errors of up to 0.5 s. Furthermore, experiments with the LiDAR and camera mounted on separate robots demonstrate that the method can jointly estimate the trajectories of independently moving sensors.

title: Seeing Beyond the Next Step: World-Model-Guided Human-Like Navigation in Multi-Agent Scenes
summary: Selecting a next motion in a populated scene is not just a matter of avoiding what is currently in the way: an action can be locally feasible yet drift onto the road instead of the crosswalk, cut into a stream of crossing pedestrians, or bottleneck a narrow passage. These failure modes are invisible from the current state alone, and acting on them requires reasoning about what each candidate action will cause. World models offer exactly this, namely action-conditioned predictions of the future, but rolling them out at every decision step is a cost deployable navigation systems cannot pay, and the field has largely traded foresight for speed. We argue this is a false dichotomy. The natural place for a world model in human-aware navigation is at training time, as a preference oracle that distills foresight into a fast policy, rather than at inference time, as an online planner. We pair a discrete visual action prior with two task-aligned world models, one for nearby social dynamics and one for future scene semantics, that score candidate actions by their predicted consequences and refine the policy through group-relative preference distillation. At deployment, both world models are removed and the policy acts in a single forward pass. Across five held-out evaluation scenarios, this yields navigation that is simultaneously safer, more socially and group-coherent, and more goal-directed than strong reactive and learned baselines, with naive observers rating the resulting motion as more human-like. Taken together, our findings point to a different approach for bringing world-model foresight into deployable agents: not accelerating rollouts, but amortizing them into the policy so that the cost of looking ahead is confined to training. title: Learning Robotic World Models with Semantic and Visual Feedback
summary: Robot world models predict action-conditioned future visual states to support robotic planning and decision making. However, visual reconstruction does not fully capture task progress, semantic evaluation alone provides limited constraints on fine-grained visual errors, and homogeneous predictions limit comparative feedback. We present RoboImagine, a framework for post-training autoregressive robotic world models through candidate-future comparisons with semantic and visual feedback. Diverse search promotes diversity among candidate trajectories under shared visual observations, action sequences, and task instructions. A frozen multimodal evaluator provides task-relevant semantic preferences through pairwise video comparisons in both presentation orders, complemented by pixel- and perceptual-level visual consistency feedback that constrains local structural and appearance errors. These signals drive policy optimization through group-relative advantages. Fixed initial context and branch-specific rolling histories support long-sequence generation with bounded context and consistent conditioning between candidate generation and policy optimization. Experiments with separately trained models on RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa cover real-world and simulated manipulation. On RT-1, under matched initialization, update counts, and evaluation protocols, RoboImagine improves PSNR by 1.26 dB and reduces LPIPS by 11.93% relative to continued supervised fine-tuning. Ablations show that diverse search improves prediction quality and that combined semantic and visual feedback yields higher external multimodal evaluation scores than visual feedback alone while maintaining comparable visual fidelity. Rolling histories further improve long-horizon prediction. These results support improving visual fidelity, task relevance, and long-horizon prediction through candidate comparison and complementary feedback.

title: Reinforcing End-to-End Autonomous Driving Safety via Negative-Aware Planning in a Unified World-Action Model
summary: World-action models (WAMs) jointly model future traffic states and driving actions for end-to-end autonomous driving in intelligent transportation systems. However, their action learning remains dominated by expert-trajectory imitation, leaving unsafe alternatives close to expert trajectories insufficiently constrained. To improve WAM robustness in safety-critical scenarios, we propose NegWAM, a safety post-training framework for unified WAMs that learns explicit safety boundaries from near-expert failure trajectories. NegWAM constructs negative trajectories that are geometrically close to the expert trajectory yet carry safety risks, uses them as repulsive anchors to steer predictions away from dangerous behavior, and encodes them as scene-conditioned rider tokens to learn scene--trajectory compatibility. During training, NegWAM jointly optimizes the flow-matching and near-expert negative objectives, while the auxiliary rider branch is discarded at inference, incurring no additional overhead. On NAVSIM v2, NegWAM achieves 40.4 EPDMS on navhard, a 4.1% relative improvement over the strongest compared scorer-free WAM baseline, and achieves 93.3 EPDMS on navtest. These results demonstrate that NegWAM achieves strong performance in safety-critical scenarios while preserving routine-driving performance. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM further demonstrates cross-benchmark generalization. The code is available at this https URL.

title: La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling
summary: World-action models adapt pretrained video generators, and vision-language-action models build on pretrained vision-language backbones; both tie policy architecture and inference cost to large transformers designed for generation rather than control. It remains unclear how much these generation-oriented choices affect control. In this work, we introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA), a compact world-action model whose policy transformer is trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. Following Fast-WAM, La-JEPA learns to predict future features jointly with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance in clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes and on LIBERO-Plus with correct instructions, while using far fewer parameters than the strongest competing policies. It runs substantially faster than Fast-WAM at comparable performance and outperforms the closest JEPA-based methods, LeapBot-WA and JEPA-WAM, on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0 without their pretrained policy backbones. On four real-robot tasks, its average success is comparable to pi0.5 and above non-embodied-pretrained baselines. Through a design study of the choices behind La-JEPA, we show that JEPA features outperform video VAE latents, most clearly out of distribution, and that training-time future prediction choices significantly impact the policy even when future prediction is skipped at inference. We correct the LIBERO-Plus instructions, as the officially released evaluator corrupts them for most variants, and re-evaluate several strong open baselines. Without a generative pretrained policy backbone, La-JEPA is better and faster than far larger policies, suggesting that robot foundation models may benefit from architectures designed for control rather than inherited from generation.

title: VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception
summary: Robotic perception increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensor suites combining cameras with emerging modalities (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, and thermal). Yet existing simulators idealize these sensors, hiding critical modality-specific failure modes that limit real-world deployment. We present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded simulation platform that elevates sensor realism to a first-class concern by modeling the raw physical measurement process for diverse conventional and emerging modalities. We expose fine-grained control over physical sensor parameters, reproducing failure modes overlooked by general-purpose simulators: pileup and glare for LiDAR; phase wrapping, saturation, and motion artifacts for iToF; refractory drops for event cameras; and history-dependent emission for thermal cameras. This enables principled cross-modality comparison on identical scenes and trajectories. We release the platform and a large indoor dataset with synchronized raw measurements and rich ground-truth annotations.
